  content: |
      import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
      import { Server, Database, CloudUpload, Download, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';
      import { Button } from './ui';
      import { getLocalServerUrl, setLocalServerUrl } from '../lib/supabase';
      
      export function ServerAndSyncSettings() {
        const [serverUrl, setServerUrlState] = useState('');
        const [testing, setTesting] = useState(false);
        const [testResult, setTestResult] = useState<{ ok: boolean; message: string } | null>(null);
      
        // Supabase migration state
        const [supabaseUrl, setSupabaseUrl] = useState('');
        const [serviceKey, setServiceKey] = useState('');
        const [syncing, setSyncing] = useState(false);
        const [syncResult, setSyncResult] = useState<any>(null);
        const [syncError, setSyncError] = useState('');
      
        useEffect(() => {
          setServerUrlState(getLocalServerUrl());
        }, []);
      
        const handleTestConnection = async () => {
          setTesting(true);
          setTestResult(null);
          try {
            const res = await fetch(`${serverUrl.replace(/\/$/, '')}/health`, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(4000) });
            if (res.ok) {
              const json = await res.json();
              setTestResult({
                ok: true,
                message: `Connected! Database: ${(json.database || 'active').toUpperCase()} (Server v${json.status})`,
              });
              setLocalServerUrl(serverUrl);
            } else {
              setTestResult({ ok: false, message: `Server responded with status ${res.status}` });
            }
          } catch (err) {
            setTestResult({
              ok: false,
              message: `Connection failed: ${(err as Error).message}. Ensure AttendX local server is running.`,
            });
          } finally {
            setTesting(false);
          }
        };
      
        const handleStartSync = async () => {
          if (!supabaseUrl || !serviceKey) {
            setSyncError('Please provide both Supabase URL and Service Role Key');
            return;
          }
          setSyncing(true);
          setSyncError('');
          setSyncResult(null);
      
          try {
            const res = await fetch(`${getLocalServerUrl()}/api/sync/to-supabase`, {
              method: 'POST',
              headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
              body: JSON.stringify({ supabaseUrl, serviceRoleKey: serviceKey }),
            });
            const data = await res.json();
            if (!res.ok) {
              setSyncError(data.error || 'Migration failed');
            } else {
              setSyncResult(data);
            }
          } catch (err) {
            setSyncError((err as Error).message);
          } finally {
            setSyncing(false);
          }
        };
      
        const handleExportBackup = () => {
          window.open(`${getLocalServerUrl()}/api/sync/export-json`, '_blank');
        };
      
        return (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '1.5rem', marginTop: '1.5rem' }}>
            {/* Local Server Config */}
            <section className="panel">
              <div className="panel-head">
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.6rem' }}>
                  <Server size={20} />
                  <h2>Local Server & Network Access</h2>
                </div>
              </div>
              <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted, #94a3b8)', marginBottom: '1rem', fontSize: '0.9rem' }}>
                Connect this web application or mobile device to your laptop's local database server.
                Works on LAN (Wi-Fi) without cloud dependencies.
              </p>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  className="input"
                  value={serverUrl}
                  onChange={(e) => setServerUrlState(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="http://localhost:3001 or http://192.168.1.50:3001"
                  style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: '280px' }}
                />
                <Button onClick={handleTestConnection} disabled={testing}>
                  <RefreshCw size={16} className={testing ? 'spin' : ''} />
                  {testing ? 'Testing...' : 'Test & Save'}
                </Button>
              </div>
              {testResult && (
                <div
                  style={{
                    marginTop: '0.75rem',
                    padding: '0.6rem 0.9rem',
                    borderRadius: '6px',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: '0.5rem',
                    fontSize: '0.88rem',
                    backgroundColor: testResult.ok ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)',
                    color: testResult.ok ? '#22c55e' : '#ef4444',
                  }}
                >
                  {testResult.ok ? <CheckCircle2 size={16} /> : <AlertCircle size={16} />}
                  {testResult.message}
                </div>
              )}
            </section>
      
            {/* 1-Click Migration to Supabase */}
            <section className="panel">
              <div className="panel-head">
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.6rem' }}>
                  <CloudUpload size={20} />
                  <h2>1-Click Migration to Supabase</h2>
                </div>
              </div>
              <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted, #94a3b8)', marginBottom: '1rem', fontSize: '0.9rem' }}>
                Push all locally collected attendance records, profiles, batches, and photo evidence from this laptop
                directly into your cloud Supabase database and storage in one linear operation.
              </p>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '0.75rem' }}>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  className="input"
                  value={supabaseUrl}
                  onChange={(e) => setSupabaseUrl(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Target Supabase URL (e.g., https://your-ref.supabase.co)"
                />
                <input
                  type="password"
                  className="input"
                  value={serviceKey}
                  onChange={(e) => setServiceKey(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Supabase Service Role Key (secret)"
                />
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', marginTop: '0.5rem' }}>
                  <Button onClick={handleStartSync} disabled={syncing}>
                    <Database size={16} />
                    {syncing ? 'Migrating Data...' : 'Migrate Everything to Supabase'}
                  </Button>
                  <Button variant="secondary" onClick={handleExportBackup}>
                    <Download size={16} />
                    Export Local Backup (JSON)
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
      
              {syncError && (
                <div
                  style={{
                    marginTop: '1rem',
                    padding: '0.75rem',
                    borderRadius: '6px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)',
                    color: '#ef4444',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: '0.5rem',
                  }}
                >
                  <AlertCircle size={16} />
                  {syncError}
                </div>
              )}
      
              {syncResult && (
                <div
                  style={{
                    marginTop: '1rem',
                    padding: '1rem',
                    borderRadius: '6px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.12)',
                    border: '1px solid rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.3)',
                  }}
                >
                  <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem', color: '#22c55e', fontWeight: 600 }}>
                    <CheckCircle2 size={18} />
                    {syncResult.message}
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ marginTop: '0.5rem', fontSize: '0.85rem', color: 'var(--text-muted, #94a3b8)' }}>
                    Evidence files uploaded: <strong>{syncResult.uploadedEvidenceCount}</strong>
                  </div>
                  <div style={{ marginTop: '0.5rem', fontSize: '0.85rem' }}>
                    <strong>Table counts:</strong>
                    <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '1rem', flexWrap: 'wrap', marginTop: '0.25rem' }}>
                      {Object.entries(syncResult.recordsMigrated || {}).map(([tbl, cnt]) => (
                        <span key={tbl} className="status status-present">
                          {tbl}: {String(cnt)}
                        </span>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </section>
          </div>
        );
      }
      
  referencedBy: {}

- path: src\components\OtpModal.tsx
  content: |
      import { useState, useRef, useEffect, type KeyboardEvent, type ClipboardEvent } from 'react';
      import { ShieldCheck, Mail, ArrowRight, RefreshCw, X, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
      import { Button } from './ui';
      import { getLocalServerUrl } from '../lib/supabase';
      
      interface OtpModalProps {
        email: string;
        purpose?: 'login' | 'signup' | 'password_reset' | 'general';
        isOpen: boolean;
        onClose: () => void;
        onSuccess: () => void;
      }
      
      export function OtpModal({ email, purpose = 'login', isOpen, onClose, onSuccess }: OtpModalProps) {
        const [digits, setDigits] = useState<string[]>(['', '', '', '', '', '']);
        const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
        const [resending, setResending] = useState(false);
        const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState(60);
        const [error, setError] = useState('');
        const [successMsg, setSuccessMsg] = useState('');
        const inputRefs = useRef<(HTMLInputElement | null)[]>([]);
      
        useEffect(() => {
          if (!isOpen) {
            setDigits(['', '', '', '', '', '']);
            setError('');
            setSuccessMsg('');
            setCountdown(60);
            return;
          }
          // Auto-focus first input when opened
          setTimeout(() => {
            inputRefs.current[0]?.focus();
          }, 100);
        }, [isOpen]);
      
        useEffect(() => {
          if (countdown > 0 && isOpen) {
            const timer = setTimeout(() => setCountdown(countdown - 1), 1000);
            return () => clearTimeout(timer);
          }
        }, [countdown, isOpen]);
      
        if (!isOpen) return null;
      
        const handleChange = (index: number, val: string) => {
          const char = val.slice(-1);
          if (!/^\d*$/.test(char)) return;
      
          const next = [...digits];
          next[index] = char;
          setDigits(next);
          setError('');
      
          if (char && index < 5) {
            inputRefs.current[index + 1]?.focus();
          }
      
          // If all 6 digits entered, auto-verify
          if (char && index === 5 && next.every((d) => d !== '')) {
            verifyCode(next.join(''));
          }
        };
      
        const handleKeyDown = (index: number, e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
          if (e.key === 'Backspace' && !digits[index] && index > 0) {
            inputRefs.current[index - 1]?.focus();
          }
        };
      
        const handlePaste = (e: ClipboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          const pasted = e.clipboardData.getData('text').trim();
          if (/^\d{6}$/.test(pasted)) {
            const arr = pasted.split('');
            setDigits(arr);
            inputRefs.current[5]?.focus();
            verifyCode(pasted);
          }
        };
      
        const verifyCode = async (codeStr: string) => {
          setLoading(true);
          setError('');
          try {
            const res = await fetch(`${getLocalServerUrl()}/api/auth/verify-otp`, {
              method: 'POST',
              headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
              body: JSON.stringify({ email, code: codeStr, purpose }),
            });
            const data = await res.json();
            if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
              setError(data.error || 'Invalid or expired verification code');
            } else {
              setSuccessMsg('Code verified successfully!');
              setTimeout(() => {
                onSuccess();
              }, 600);
            }
          } catch (err) {
            setError((err as Error).message);
          } finally {
            setLoading(false);
          }
        };
      
        const handleResend = async () => {
          if (countdown > 0) return;
          setResending(true);
          setError('');
          try {
            const res = await fetch(`${getLocalServerUrl()}/api/auth/send-otp`, {
              method: 'POST',
              headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
              body: JSON.stringify({ email, purpose }),
            });
            const data = await res.json();
            if (!res.ok || !data.success) {
              setError(data.error || data.message || 'Failed to resend code');
            } else {
              setCountdown(60);
              setSuccessMsg('New security code sent to your email');
              setTimeout(() => setSuccessMsg(''), 4000);
            }
          } catch (err) {
            setError((err as Error).message);
          } finally {
            setResending(false);
          }
        };
      
        return (
          <div className="modal-backdrop" onClick={onClose} style={{ zIndex: 1000 }}>
            <div
              className="modal-content"
              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
              style={{
                maxWidth: '420px',
                padding: '2rem',
                background: '#131d1b',
                border: '1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25)',
                borderRadius: '16px',
                boxShadow: '0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)',
                textAlign: 'center',
                color: '#f1f5f9',
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', marginBottom: '-10px' }}>
                <button className="icon-button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close modal">
                  <X size={18} />
                </button>
              </div>
      
              <div
                style={{
                  width: '56px',
                  height: '56px',
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  background: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)',
                  border: '1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3)',
                  display: 'grid',
                  placeItems: 'center',
                  margin: '0 auto 1.25rem',
                  color: '#10b981',
                }}
              >
                <ShieldCheck size={28} />
              </div>
      
              <h3 style={{ fontSize: '1.35rem', fontWeight: 700, margin: '0 0 0.4rem', color: '#ffffff' }}>
                Security Verification
              </h3>
              <p style={{ fontSize: '0.88rem', color: '#94a3b8', margin: '0 0 1.5rem', lineHeight: 1.5 }}>
                Enter the 6-digit code sent via Gmail to <br />
                <strong style={{ color: '#34d399' }}>{email}</strong>
              </p>
      
              {/* 6 Digit segmented input boxes */}
              <div
                style={{
                  display: 'flex',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  gap: '0.5rem',
                  marginBottom: '1.25rem',
                }}
              >
                {digits.map((digit, idx) => (
                  <input
                    key={idx}
                    ref={(el) => { inputRefs.current[idx] = el; }}
                    type="text"
                    inputMode="numeric"
                    maxLength={1}
                    value={digit}
                    onChange={(e) => handleChange(idx, e.target.value)}
                    onKeyDown={(e) => handleKeyDown(idx, e)}
                    onPaste={handlePaste}
                    style={{
                      width: '46px',
                      height: '54px',
                      fontSize: '1.5rem',
                      fontWeight: 700,
                      textAlign: 'center',
                      background: '#0b1311',
                      border: digit ? '2px solid #10b981' : '1px solid #223733',
                      borderRadius: '10px',
                      color: '#ffffff',
                      outline: 'none',
                      boxShadow: digit ? '0 0 10px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25)' : 'none',
                      transition: 'all 0.15s ease',
                    }}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
      
              {error && (
                <div
                  style={{
                    padding: '0.6rem',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)',
                    color: '#ef4444',
                    fontSize: '0.85rem',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    gap: '0.4rem',
                    marginBottom: '1rem',
                  }}
                >
                  <AlertCircle size={15} />
                  {error}
                </div>
              )}
      
              {successMsg && (
                <div
                  style={{
                    padding: '0.6rem',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15)',
                    color: '#22c55e',
                    fontSize: '0.85rem',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    gap: '0.4rem',
                    marginBottom: '1rem',
                  }}
                >
                  <CheckCircle2 size={15} />
                  {successMsg}
                </div>
              )}
      
              <Button
                style={{ width: '100%', marginBottom: '1rem', justifyContent: 'center' }}
                disabled={loading || digits.some((d) => !d)}
                onClick={() => verifyCode(digits.join(''))}
              >
                {loading ? 'Verifying...' : 'Verify Code'}
                <ArrowRight size={16} />
              </Button>
      
              <div style={{ fontSize: '0.85rem', color: '#64748b' }}>
                Didn't receive the email?{' '}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="text-button"
                  disabled={countdown > 0 || resending}
                  onClick={handleResend}
                  style={{
                    color: countdown > 0 ? '#64748b' : '#38bdf8',
                    cursor: countdown > 0 ? 'default' : 'pointer',
                    fontWeight: 600,
                  }}
                >
                  {resending ? 'Sending...' : countdown > 0 ? `Resend in ${countdown}s` : 'Resend code'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      }
      
  referencedBy: {}
- path: src\components\ui.tsx
  content: |
      import type { ButtonHTMLAttributes, ReactNode } from 'react'
      import { CheckCircle2, Clock3, Flag, XCircle } from 'lucide-react'
      
      export function Button({ className = '', variant = 'primary', ...props }: ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & { variant?: 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'ghost' | 'danger' }) {
        return <button className={`button button-${variant} ${className}`} {...props} />
      }
      
      export function StatusPill({ status }: { status: string }) {
        const config: Record<string, { icon: ReactNode; label: string }> = {
          present: { icon: <CheckCircle2 size={14} />, label: 'Present' },
          flagged: { icon: <Flag size={14} />, label: 'Needs review' },
          rejected: { icon: <XCircle size={14} />, label: 'Rejected' },
          pending_review: { icon: <Clock3 size={14} />, label: 'Pending' },
          absent: { icon: <Clock3 size={14} />, label: 'Not marked' }
        }
        const item = config[status] || config.pending_review
        return <span className={`status status-${status}`}>{item.icon}{item.label}</span>
      }
      
      export function Initials({ name, size = 'md' }: { name: string; size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' }) {
        const letters = name.split(' ').map((part) => part[0]).slice(0, 2).join('')
        return <span className={`avatar avatar-${size}`} aria-hidden="true">{letters}</span>
      }
      
      export function Logo({ compact = false, size = 36 }: { compact?: boolean; size?: number }) {
        if (compact) {
          return (
            <div className="logo" style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.65rem' }}>
              <img
                src="/logom.png"
                alt="AttendX"
                style={{
                  width: `${size}px`,
                  height: `${size}px`,
                  borderRadius: '8px',
                  objectFit: 'contain',
                  display: 'block'
                }}
              />
            </div>
          );
        }
      
        return (
          <div className="logo" style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.65rem' }}>
            <img
              src="/logo.png"
              alt="AttendX Logo"
              style={{
                height: `${size + 8}px`,
                width: 'auto',
                maxWidth: '220px',
                objectFit: 'contain',
                display: 'block'
              }}
            />
          </div>
        );
      }

      package in.attendx.app;
      
      import android.content.ContentResolver;
      import android.content.Intent;
      import android.os.Build;
      import android.provider.Settings;
      import com.getcapacitor.Plugin;
      import com.getcapacitor.PluginCall;
      import com.getcapacitor.PluginMethod;
      import com.getcapacitor.annotation.CapacitorPlugin;
      import com.getcapacitor.JSObject;
      
      @CapacitorPlugin(name = "DeveloperMode")
      public class DeveloperModePlugin extends Plugin {
      
          private boolean isDevModeOn() {
              try {
                  ContentResolver cr = getContext().getContentResolver();
                  int devGlobal = 0;
                  int devSecure = 0;
                  int adbGlobal = 0;
                  int adbSecure = 0;
      
                  try {
                      devGlobal = Settings.Global.getInt(cr, Settings.Global.DEVELOPMENT_SETTINGS_ENABLED, 0);
                  } catch (Exception ignored) {}
      
                  try {
                      devSecure = Settings.Secure.getInt(cr, "development_settings_enabled", 0);
                  } catch (Exception ignored) {}
      
                  try {
                      adbGlobal = Settings.Global.getInt(cr, Settings.Global.ADB_ENABLED, 0);
                  } catch (Exception ignored) {}
      
                  try {
                      adbSecure = Settings.Secure.getInt(cr, Settings.Secure.ADB_ENABLED, 0);
                  } catch (Exception ignored) {}
      
                  return (devGlobal != 0) || (devSecure != 0) || (adbGlobal != 0) || (adbSecure != 0);
              } catch (Exception e) {
                  return false;
              }
          }
      
          @PluginMethod
          public void isDeveloperModeEnabled(PluginCall call) {
              boolean enabled = isDevModeOn();
              JSObject ret = new JSObject();
              ret.put("enabled", enabled);
              ret.put("developerMode", enabled);
              call.resolve(ret);
          }
      
          @PluginMethod
          public void check(PluginCall call) {
              boolean enabled = isDevModeOn();
              JSObject ret = new JSObject();
              ret.put("enabled", enabled);
              ret.put("developerMode", enabled);
              ret.put("mockLocation", false);
              ret.put("rooted", false);
              ret.put("platform", "android");
              call.resolve(ret);
          }
      
          @PluginMethod
          public void openSettings(PluginCall call) {
              try {
                  Intent intent = new Intent(Settings.ACTION_APPLICATION_DEVELOPMENT_SETTINGS);
                  intent.setFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK);
                  getContext().startActivity(intent);
                  call.resolve();
              } catch (Exception e) {
                  try {
                      Intent fallback = new Intent(Settings.ACTION_SETTINGS);
                      fallback.setFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK);
                      getContext().startActivity(fallback);
                      call.resolve();
                  } catch (Exception ex) {
                      call.reject("Could not open settings", ex);
                  }
              }
          }
      }

- path: android\app\build.gradle
  content: |
      apply plugin: 'com.android.application'
      
      android {
          namespace "in.attendx.app"
          compileSdk rootProject.ext.compileSdkVersion
          defaultConfig {
              applicationId "in.attendx.app"
              minSdkVersion rootProject.ext.minSdkVersion
              targetSdkVersion rootProject.ext.targetSdkVersion
              versionCode 2
              versionName "1.0.2"
              testInstrumentationRunner "androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner"
              aaptOptions {
                   // Files and dirs to omit from the packaged assets dir, modified to accommodate modern web apps.
                   // Default: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/frameworks/base/+/282e181b58cf72b6ca770dc7ca5f91f135444502/tools/aapt/AaptAssets.cpp#61
                  ignoreAssetsPattern '!.svn:!.git:!.ds_store:!*.scc:.*:!CVS:!thumbs.db:!picasa.ini:!*~:*.apk'
              }
          }
          buildTypes {
              release {
                  minifyEnabled true
                  shrinkResources true
                  proguardFiles getDefaultProguardFile('proguard-android.txt'), 'proguard-rules.pro'
              }
          }
      }
      
      repositories {
          flatDir{
              dirs '../capacitor-cordova-android-plugins/src/main/libs', 'libs'
          }
      }
      
      dependencies {
          implementation fileTree(include: ['*.jar'], dir: 'libs')
          implementation "androidx.appcompat:appcompat:$androidxAppCompatVersion"
          implementation "androidx.coordinatorlayout:coordinatorlayout:$androidxCoordinatorLayoutVersion"
          implementation "androidx.core:core-splashscreen:$coreSplashScreenVersion"
          implementation project(':capacitor-android')
          testImplementation "junit:junit:$junitVersion"
          androidTestImplementation "androidx.test.ext:junit:$androidxJunitVersion"
          androidTestImplementation "androidx.test.espresso:espresso-core:$androidxEspressoCoreVersion"
          implementation project(':capacitor-cordova-android-plugins')
      }
      
      apply from: 'capacitor.build.gradle'
      
      try {
          def servicesJSON = file('google-services.json')
          if (servicesJSON.text) {
              apply plugin: 'com.google.gms.google-services'

- path: src\styles.css
  content: |
      @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Manrope:wght@600;700;800&display=swap');
      
      :root {
        font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;
        color: #17201e;
        background: #f4f7f5;
        font-synthesis: none;
        text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
        --ink: #17201e;
        --muted: #687471;
        --line: #dfe6e3;
        --surface: #fff;
        --green: #167d64;
        --green-dark: #0f5e4d;
        --green-pale: #e5f4ee;
        --blue: #376fc5;
        --blue-pale: #eaf1fc;
        --amber: #b97919;
        --amber-pale: #fff3dc;
        --rose: #bc4b57;
        --rose-pale: #fcebed;
        --sidebar: #111a18;
      }
      
      /* Live-data states */
      .data-state { display: flex; min-height: 170px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; padding: 25px; color: #81908b; text-align: center; }
      .data-state strong { color: var(--ink); font-size: 12px; }
      .data-state span { max-width: 460px; font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.5; }
      .data-state svg { color: var(--green); }
      .data-error svg { color: var(--rose); }
      .small-empty { display: grid; min-height: 95px; place-items: center; padding: 18px; color: #87938f; font-size: 10px; text-align: center; }
      .summary-list { padding: 8px 18px; }
      .session-start-card { max-width: 560px; padding: 22px; }
      .session-start-card .field-label { margin-bottom: 18px; }
      .review-note { padding: 0 18px; }
      .review-note textarea { min-height: 72px; padding-top: 10px; resize: vertical; }
      .settings-input { width: min(220px, 100%); }
      .spin { animation: spin .8s linear infinite; }
      @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
      .camera-modal { position: fixed; z-index: 100; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 18px; background: rgba(6,13,11,.82); }
      .camera-surface { position: relative; display: flex; width: min(720px, 100%); max-height: calc(100vh - 36px); flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; align-items: center; padding: 12px; border-radius: 7px; background: #0f1715; }
      .camera-surface video { width: 100%; max-height: calc(100vh - 125px); border-radius: 5px; object-fit: contain; background: #050807; }
      .camera-close { position: absolute; z-index: 2; top: 18px; right: 18px; color: white; background: rgba(0,0,0,.5); }
      .camera-close:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,.72); }
      .app-loading { display: flex; min-height: 100vh; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 20px; color: var(--green); background: var(--sidebar); }
      .app-failure { display: flex; min-height: 100vh; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 16px; padding: 28px; color: var(--ink); background: #f4f7f5; text-align: center; }
      .app-failure-icon { display: grid; width: 58px; height: 58px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #f5c9c6; border-radius: 50%; color: var(--rose); background: #fff3f2; }
      .app-failure h1 { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 22px; }
      .app-failure p { max-width: 380px; margin: 0 0 5px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; }
      .password-change-page { display: grid; min-height: 100vh; place-items: center; padding: 20px; }
      .password-change-card { width: min(460px, 100%); padding: 30px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; background: white; text-align: center; }
      .password-change-card > p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.6; }
      .password-change-card .field-label { text-align: left; }
      .login-error { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin-bottom: 14px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #efcbd0; border-radius: 6px; color: #9b3741; background: #fff5f6; font-size: 10px; }
      .reset-heading { margin-bottom: 18px; }
      .reset-heading h2 { margin-bottom: 6px; }
      .reset-heading p, .reset-success p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.5; }
      .reset-success { padding: 25px 5px; text-align: center; }
      .reset-success svg { color: var(--green); }
      
      @media (max-width: 560px) {
        .settings-input { width: 100%; }
        .camera-modal { padding: 0; }
        .camera-surface { width: 100%; height: 100%; max-height: none; justify-content: center; border-radius: 0; }
      }
      
      * { box-sizing: border-box; }
      body { margin: 0; min-width: 320px; min-height: 100vh; background: #f4f7f5; }
      button, input { font: inherit; }
      button { color: inherit; }
      button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(22,125,100,.25); outline-offset: 2px; }
      h1, h2, p { margin-top: 0; }

      .icon-button { display: inline-grid; width: 36px; height: 36px; flex: 0 0 auto; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; }

      .logo-mark i:nth-child(1) { height: 7px; }.logo-mark i:nth-child(2) { height: 15px; }.logo-mark i:nth-child(3) { height: 11px; }
      
      /* Login */
      .login-page { display: grid; min-height: 100vh; grid-template-columns: minmax(400px, 1.05fr) minmax(500px, .95fr); background: white; }
      .login-brand { position: relative; overflow: hidden; color: white; background: #111b18; }
      .login-brand::after { position: absolute; right: -120px; bottom: -150px; width: 420px; height: 420px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-radius: 50%; content: ''; box-shadow: 0 0 0 65px rgba(255,255,255,.025), 0 0 0 130px rgba(255,255,255,.018); }
      .login-brand-inner { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: flex; width: min(680px, 100%); min-height: 100%; flex-direction: column; padding: 52px clamp(40px, 7vw, 100px); }
      .login-pitch { margin: auto 0; }

      .login-pitch h1 { max-width: 620px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: clamp(42px, 5vw, 70px); line-height: 1.04; }
      .login-pitch > p:last-child { max-width: 530px; color: #aebbb7; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.7; }
      .login-signals { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 10px; }
      .login-signals > span { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 25px 1fr; padding: 15px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1); border-radius: 7px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.035); }
      .login-signals svg { grid-row: span 2; color: #65d0b0; }
      .login-signals strong { font-size: 12px; }.login-signals small { color: #869590; font-size: 10px; }
      .login-copyright { margin: 23px 0 0; color: #687873; font-size: 10px; }
      .login-form-side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 45px clamp(40px, 7vw, 105px); }
      .login-mobile-logo { display: none; }.login-mobile-logo .logo { color: var(--ink); }
      .login-form { width: 100%; max-width: 465px; margin: auto; }
      .login-heading { margin-bottom: 28px; }.login-heading h2 { margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 30px; }.login-heading > p:last-child { color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; }
      .login-lock { display: none; }
      .role-picker { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 23px; }
      .role-picker button { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; padding: 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; background: white; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; }
      .role-picker button > span { display: grid; width: 31px; height: 31px; place-items: center; margin-bottom: 10px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--muted); background: #eff3f1; }

      .demo-notice { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 16px; padding: 11px; border-radius: 6px; color: #4e6961; background: #eff7f4; font-size: 10px; }.demo-notice svg { flex: 0 0 auto; color: var(--green); }
      .login-help { margin: 30px auto 0; color: #8b9693; font-size: 10px; text-align: center; }
      
      /* Shell */
      .app-shell { min-height: 100vh; }

      .main-nav { padding: 24px 13px; }.nav-eyebrow { margin: 0 11px 10px; color: #687873; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; }
      .main-nav button { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 43px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 4px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: #9aa9a5; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-align: left; }
      .main-nav button:hover { color: white; background: rgba(255,255,255,.05); }.main-nav button.active { color: white; background: #1d2d29; }.main-nav button.active svg { color: #58c5a5; }.main-nav button b { min-width: 20px; margin-left: auto; padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 9px; color: #ffc6cb; background: #623139; font-size: 9px; text-align: center; }
      .sidebar-foot { margin-top: auto; padding: 16px 13px 20px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07); }
      .account-button { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: white; background: rgba(255,255,255,.04); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; }.account-button > span:nth-child(2) { min-width: 0; flex: 1; }.account-button strong, .account-button small { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }.account-button strong { font-size: 11px; }.account-button small { margin-top: 2px; color: #778681; font-size: 9px; }
      .signout { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin: 11px 8px 0; padding: 7px 2px; border: 0; color: #82918d; background: none; cursor: pointer; font-size: 11px; }
      .workspace { min-height: 100vh; margin-left: 242px; }
      .topbar { position: sticky; z-index: 10; top: 0; display: flex; height: 65px; align-items: center; padding: 0 clamp(22px, 4vw, 48px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: rgba(255,255,255,.94); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); }
      .topbar-brand, .menu-button { display: none; }.role-chip { padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 5px; color: var(--green-dark); background: var(--green-pale); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; }
      .topbar-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin-left: auto; }.notification-button { position: relative; }.notification-button i { position: absolute; top: 7px; right: 7px; width: 6px; height: 6px; border: 1px solid white; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--rose); }
      .compact-profile { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 3px 4px 3px 3px; border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }
      .content { width: min(1480px, 100%); margin: 0 auto; padding: 34px clamp(22px, 4vw, 48px) 60px; }
      .mobile-nav { display: none; }
      .avatar { display: inline-grid; flex: 0 0 auto; place-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); border-radius: 50%; color: #dff8f0; background: #2a6959; font-weight: 700; }.avatar-sm { width: 30px; height: 30px; font-size: 9px; }.avatar-md { width: 35px; height: 35px; font-size: 10px; }.avatar-lg { width: 76px; height: 76px; font-size: 20px; }
      
      /* Dashboard */
      .session-banner { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; margin-bottom: 20px; padding: 14px 45px 14px 15px; border: 1px solid #c4e5d9; border-radius: 7px; background: #edf8f4; }.banner-icon { display: grid; width: 37px; height: 37px; flex: 0 0 auto; place-items: center; border-radius: 6px; color: white; background: var(--green); }.session-banner > div:nth-child(2) { min-width: 0; flex: 1; }.session-banner strong, .session-banner span { display: block; }.session-banner strong { font-size: 12px; }.session-banner span { margin-top: 2px; color: #55736a; font-size: 10px; }.dismiss { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; display: grid; width: 28px; height: 28px; place-items: center; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; }
      .metric-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 13px; margin-bottom: 18px; }.metric { min-width: 0; padding: 17px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; background: white; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(16,35,29,.025); }.metric-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; }.metric-icon { display: grid; width: 30px; height: 30px; place-items: center; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--green); background: var(--green-pale); }.metric > strong { display: block; margin: 8px 0 3px; font-family: 'Manrope'; font-size: 25px; }.metric > small { display: block; overflow: hidden; color: #84908d; font-size: 9px; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }.metric-blue .metric-icon { color: var(--blue); background: var(--blue-pale); }.metric-amber .metric-icon { color: var(--amber); background: var(--amber-pale); }.metric-rose .metric-icon { color: var(--rose); background: var(--rose-pale); }
      .panel { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; background: white; box-shadow: 0 2px 9px rgba(16,35,29,.025); }.panel-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 18px 19px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0ef; }.panel-head .eyebrow { margin-bottom: 3px; }.panel-head h2 { font-size: 16px; }
      .dashboard-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.55fr) minmax(290px, .75fr); gap: 18px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
      .class-list { padding: 4px 10px 10px; }.class-row { display: grid; width: 100%; grid-template-columns: 39px minmax(0, 1fr) auto 18px; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 12px 9px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f2f1; background: white; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; }.class-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }.class-row:hover { background: #f8faf9; }.class-row-active { border-radius: 6px; background: #f4faf7; }.class-badge { display: grid; width: 38px; height: 38px; place-items: center; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--green); background: var(--green-pale); }.class-badge-amber { color: var(--amber); background: var(--amber-pale); }.class-badge-lilac { color: #7657a9; background: #f1ebfa; }.class-info, .class-time { min-width: 0; }.class-info strong, .class-info small, .class-time strong, .class-time small { display: block; }.class-info strong { overflow: hidden; font-size: 11px; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }.class-info small, .class-time small { margin-top: 3px; color: #89938f; font-size: 9px; }.class-info i { display: inline-block; width: 2px; height: 2px; margin: 0 4px 2px; border-radius: 50%; background: #9ba5a2; }.class-time { text-align: right; }.class-time strong { font-size: 10px; }.row-chevron { color: #9ba5a2; }
      .chart-wrap { display: flex; height: 220px; padding: 24px 18px 4px; }.chart-labels { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; padding-bottom: 25px; color: #9aa4a1; font-size: 8px; }.chart { position: relative; min-width: 0; flex: 1; margin-left: 9px; color: var(--green); }.chart-grid { position: absolute; inset: 0 0 25px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; }.chart-grid i { width: 100%; border-top: 1px dashed #e4e9e7; }.chart svg { position: absolute; inset: 0 0 25px; width: 100%; height: calc(100% - 25px); }.chart-x { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: #919b98; font-size: 8px; }.chart-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 18px; border-top: 1px solid #edf0ef; font-size: 10px; }.chart-foot span { color: var(--muted); }.legend-dot { display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 7px; margin-right: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green); }
      .recent-panel { overflow: hidden; }.table-scroll { overflow-x: auto; }table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }th { padding: 10px 16px; color: #89938f; background: #fafbfb; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 700; text-align: left; text-transform: uppercase; }td { padding: 11px 16px; border-top: 1px solid #edf0ef; color: #34403d; font-size: 10px; }td > strong, td > small { display: block; }td > small { margin-top: 3px; color: #8d9794; font-size: 8px; }.table-class { display: flex; min-width: 190px; align-items: center; gap: 9px; }.table-class > span:last-child { min-width: 0; }.table-class strong, .table-class small { display: block; }.table-class strong { overflow: hidden; max-width: 260px; color: var(--ink); font-size: 10px; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }.table-class small { margin-top: 2px; color: #87928e; font-size: 8px; }.mini-class-icon { display: grid; width: 29px; height: 29px; flex: 0 0 auto; place-items: center; border-radius: 5px; color: var(--green); background: var(--green-pale); }.location-cell { display: flex; min-width: 160px; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }.location-cell svg { color: #8a9692; }.location-cell small { margin-left: 3px; color: #8b9693; }
      .status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; }.status-present { color: #11664f; background: var(--green-pale); }.status-flagged { color: #9a6412; background: var(--amber-pale); }.status-rejected { color: #a33743; background: var(--rose-pale); }.status-pending_review, .status-absent { color: #687471; background: #edf1ef; }
      
      /* Lists and classes */
      .filter-row { display: flex; gap: 9px; margin-bottom: 15px; }.search-input { display: flex; width: 260px; height: 39px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: white; }.search-wide { width: min(420px, 100%); }.search-input svg { color: #8b9692; }.search-input input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; color: var(--ink); font-size: 11px; }.filter-button { display: inline-flex; height: 39px; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: white; cursor: pointer; color: #53605c; font-size: 10px; }.table-panel { overflow: hidden; }.table-title { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 14px 16px; }.table-title strong { font-size: 11px; }.table-title span { color: #8b9693; font-size: 9px; }
      .class-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 15px; }.class-card { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; background: white; }.class-card-top { display: flex; height: 92px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 17px; background: #def1ea; }.class-card-top.class-amber { background: #fff0d4; }.class-card-top.class-lilac { background: #eee7f8; }.class-card-top .class-badge { background: rgba(255,255,255,.75); }.class-card-code { margin: 8px 8px 0 auto; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; }.class-card-top .icon-button { margin-top: -2px; }.class-card-body { padding: 17px; }.class-card-body h2 { min-height: 46px; font-size: 16px; }.class-card-body > p { margin: 3px 0 17px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; }.progress-line { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }.progress-line > span { height: 6px; flex: 1; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 3px; background: #edf1ef; }.progress-line i { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; background: var(--green); }.progress-line strong { font-size: 11px; }.class-card-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 17px; padding-top: 13px; border-top: 1px solid #edf0ef; color: #7c8783; font-size: 9px; }
      
      /* Attendance capture */
      .back-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 20px; padding: 0; border: 0; color: #687471; background: none; cursor: pointer; font-size: 11px; }.capture-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 285px; gap: 18px; align-items: start; }.capture-main { min-width: 0; padding: 25px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; background: white; }.capture-heading { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; }.capture-heading h1 { font-size: 28px; }.capture-heading > div > p:last-child { max-width: 610px; margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.6; }.secure-badge { display: inline-flex; height: fit-content; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 5px; color: var(--green-dark); background: var(--green-pale); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; }
      .stepper { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); margin: 25px 0; }.step { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: #9aa4a1; font-size: 9px; }.step::before, .step::after { position: absolute; top: 13px; width: 50%; border-top: 1px solid #dfe5e2; content: ''; }.step::before { left: 0; }.step::after { right: 0; }.step:first-child::before, .step:last-child::after { display: none; }.step > span { z-index: 1; display: grid; width: 27px; height: 27px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #d9e0dd; border-radius: 50%; background: white; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; }.step-done::before, .step-done::after { border-color: #8fc9b8; }.step-done > span { color: white; border-color: var(--green); background: var(--green); }.step-current small { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }
      .inline-error { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; margin-bottom: 13px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #efcbd0; border-radius: 6px; color: #9b3741; background: #fff5f6; font-size: 10px; }.capture-card { max-width: 660px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #e5eae8; border-radius: 7px; background: #fbfcfb; }.centered-card { text-align: center; }.scanner-box { display: flex; min-height: 280px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px dashed #afc2bc; border-radius: 7px; color: var(--green); background: #f2f8f6; }.scanner-box > span { margin-top: 16px; color: var(--ink); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }.scanner-box > small { margin-top: 5px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; }.scanner-trigger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 19px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid #b9d7ce; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--green-dark); background: white; cursor: pointer; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; }.capture-divider { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 15px 0; color: #98a29f; font-size: 8px; }.capture-divider::before, .capture-divider::after { flex: 1; border-top: 1px solid #e2e7e5; content: ''; }.capture-card > .full-button { margin-top: 13px; }
      .capture-icon { display: grid; width: 62px; height: 62px; place-items: center; margin: 15px auto; border-radius: 50%; color: var(--green); background: var(--green-pale); }.capture-icon-success { color: white; background: var(--green); }.centered-card h2 { margin: 8px 0; font-size: 19px; }.centered-card > p { max-width: 470px; margin: 0 auto 18px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.6; }.web-trust-note { display: flex; max-width: 480px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0 auto 17px; padding: 10px; border-radius: 6px; color: #7a5b24; background: var(--amber-pale); font-size: 9px; text-align: left; }.location-reading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; margin-top: 16px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: white; font-size: 9px; }.location-reading > span:first-child { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
      .photo-frame { position: relative; display: grid; width: min(320px, 100%); aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; margin: 0 auto 17px; border: 1px dashed #afc2bc; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--green); background: #eef5f2; }.photo-frame img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }.photo-placeholder { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }.photo-placeholder span { max-width: 200px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; }.photo-corners::before, .photo-corners::after { position: absolute; width: 25px; height: 25px; border-color: var(--green); border-style: solid; content: ''; }.photo-corners::before { top: 13px; left: 13px; border-width: 2px 0 0 2px; }.photo-corners::after { right: 13px; bottom: 13px; border-width: 0 2px 2px 0; }.photo-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; }.review-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }.review-top h2 { font-size: 19px; }.evidence-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr; gap: 10px; margin: 17px 0; }.evidence-grid > div > span, .evidence-photo-grid > div > span { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; text-align: left; }.evidence-grid img, .empty-evidence { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16/10; border-radius: 6px; object-fit: cover; }.empty-evidence { display: grid; place-items: center; color: #98a7a2; background: #e7eeeb; }.review-facts { border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: white; }.review-facts > div { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 11px; border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0ef; }.review-facts > div:last-child { border: 0; }.review-facts svg { color: var(--green); }.review-facts strong, .review-facts small { display: block; }.review-facts strong { font-size: 10px; }.review-facts small { margin-top: 2px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 8px; }.microcopy { margin: 9px 0 0; color: #8c9693; font-size: 8px; text-align: center; }
      .success-card { max-width: 550px; margin: 20px auto; padding: 35px; text-align: center; }.success-mark { display: grid; width: 66px; height: 66px; place-items: center; margin: 0 auto 18px; border-radius: 50%; color: white; background: var(--green); box-shadow: 0 0 0 9px var(--green-pale); }.success-card h2 { margin-bottom: 9px; font-size: 23px; }.success-card > p:not(.eyebrow) { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.6; }.pending-box { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 21px 0; padding: 13px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--green); background: var(--green-pale); text-align: left; }.pending-box strong, .pending-box small { display: block; }.pending-box strong { color: var(--ink); font-size: 10px; }.pending-box small { color: #60756f; font-size: 8px; }
      .capture-aside { display: grid; gap: 12px; }.aside-session, .trust-list, .native-note { padding: 17px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; background: white; }.live-dot { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 4px; color: #a33c47; background: var(--rose-pale); font-size: 8px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; }.live-dot::before { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: #c84a57; content: ''; }.aside-session p { margin: 15px 0 4px; font-family: 'Manrope'; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; }.aside-session > strong { color: var(--green); font-size: 10px; }.aside-session > div { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 10px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; }.trust-list .eyebrow { margin-bottom: 12px; }.trust-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 10px 0; font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; }.trust-item small { color: #909a97; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 500; }.trust-icon { display: grid; width: 29px; height: 29px; place-items: center; border-radius: 5px; color: #8c9793; background: #edf1ef; }.trust-complete { color: white; background: var(--green); }.trust-active { color: var(--green); background: var(--green-pale); }.native-note { display: flex; gap: 9px; color: var(--green); }.native-note strong, .native-note small { display: block; }.native-note strong { color: var(--ink); font-size: 10px; }.native-note small { margin-top: 3px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 8px; line-height: 1.45; }
      
      /* Faculty and admin */
      .live-panel { overflow: hidden; }.live-dot-label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; color: var(--rose); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; }.live-dot-label i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--rose); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--rose-pale); }.live-dot-label.muted { color: #87928e; }.live-dot-label.muted i { background: #9ca6a3; box-shadow: none; }.empty-live, .live-mini { display: flex; min-height: 290px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 20px; text-align: center; }.empty-live > div { display: grid; width: 54px; height: 54px; place-items: center; margin-bottom: 13px; border-radius: 7px; color: var(--green); background: var(--green-pale); }.empty-live strong { font-size: 12px; }.empty-live p { max-width: 220px; margin: 6px auto 14px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; line-height: 1.5; }.live-mini svg { width: 110px; height: 110px; }.live-mini > strong { margin-top: 10px; font-family: 'Manrope'; font-size: 24px; }.live-mini > strong small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; }.live-mini > span { margin: 3px 0 12px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 8px; }
      .session-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(400px, .9fr) minmax(410px, 1.1fr); gap: 18px; }.qr-panel { overflow: hidden; }.session-live-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 16px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0ef; color: var(--muted); font-size: 9px; }.qr-stage { display: flex; min-height: 400px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #f7faf8; }.qr-surface { padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: white; box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(13,42,34,.08); }.qr-surface svg { display: block; max-width: 245px; height: auto; }.qr-refresh { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: 14px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; }.qr-refresh strong { color: var(--ink); }.qr-footer { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); border-top: 1px solid #edf0ef; }.qr-footer > div { padding: 14px 10px; border-right: 1px solid #edf0ef; text-align: center; }.qr-footer > div:last-child { border: 0; }.qr-footer strong, .qr-footer span { display: block; }.qr-footer strong { font-family: 'Manrope'; font-size: 19px; }.qr-footer span { margin-top: 2px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 8px; }.green-text { color: var(--green); }.amber-text { color: var(--amber); }
      .roster-panel { overflow: hidden; }.roster-list { padding: 5px 14px; }.roster-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 31px minmax(0,1fr) 65px 87px; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 12px 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0ef; }.roster-row > span:nth-child(2), .roster-time { min-width: 0; }.roster-row strong, .roster-row small { display: block; }.roster-row strong { overflow: hidden; font-size: 10px; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }.roster-row small { margin-top: 2px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 8px; }.roster-time { color: #3e4946; font-size: 9px; }.roster-more { margin: 14px auto; }
      .admin-grid { grid-template-columns: 1.3fr .7fr; }.alert-list { padding: 4px 12px 12px; }.review-row { display: grid; width: 100%; grid-template-columns: 33px 1fr 16px; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 11px 5px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0ef; background: white; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; }.review-row > span:nth-child(2) { min-width: 0; }.review-row strong, .review-row small { display: block; }.review-row strong { font-size: 10px; }.review-row small { overflow: hidden; margin-top: 3px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 8px; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }.review-icon { display: grid; width: 32px; height: 32px; place-items: center; border-radius: 5px; }.review-rose { color: var(--rose); background: var(--rose-pale); }.review-amber { color: var(--amber); background: var(--amber-pale); }.review-blue { color: var(--blue); background: var(--blue-pale); }.review-gray { color: #65716e; background: #edf1ef; }.health-check { color: var(--green); }.health-list { padding: 8px 18px; }.health-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0ef; font-size: 9px; }.health-row span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }.health-row span i, .green-dot, .active-status i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green); }.health-row strong { color: var(--green); font-size: 8px; }.health-foot { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 12px 18px; border-top: 1px solid #edf0ef; color: var(--muted); font-size: 8px; }
      .role-text { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: capitalize; }.role-student { color: var(--blue); background: var(--blue-pale); }.role-faculty { color: var(--green); background: var(--green-pale); }.role-admin { color: #71529f; background: #f0eafa; }.active-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; color: var(--green); font-size: 8px; font-weight: 700; }.web-label { color: var(--muted); font-size: 8px; font-weight: 700; }
      
      /* Review, settings, profile */
      .review-stats { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 15px; }.review-stats > div { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 7px; background: white; }.review-stats strong, .review-stats small { display: block; }.review-stats strong { font-family: 'Manrope'; font-size: 16px; }.review-stats small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 8px; }.review-detail-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(400px, 1fr) minmax(390px, .85fr); gap: 15px; }.review-list-panel { overflow: hidden; }.queue-list { padding: 7px 10px; }.queue-item { display: grid; width: 100%; grid-template-columns: 34px minmax(0,1fr) auto 16px; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 12px 8px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0ef; border-radius: 5px; background: white; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; }.queue-item.active { background: #f1f8f5; }.queue-item strong, .queue-item small { display: block; }.queue-item strong { font-size: 10px; }.queue-item small { margin-top: 3px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 8px; }.queue-item em { color: var(--muted); font-size: 8px; font-style: normal; }.evidence-panel { padding-bottom: 14px; }.evidence-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0ef; }.evidence-head h2 { display: inline-block; margin-right: 8px; }.evidence-person { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin: 14px 18px; }.evidence-person strong, .evidence-person small { display: block; }.evidence-person strong { font-size: 10px; }.evidence-person small { margin-top: 2px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 8px; }.evidence-photo-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.35fr; gap: 9px; padding: 0 18px; }.placeholder-photo { display: grid; aspect-ratio: 16/10; place-items: center; border-radius: 6px; color: #80918c; background: #dfe8e4; }.placeholder-selfie { background: #e6efec; }.placeholder-room { background: #e8e9e7; }.evidence-facts { margin: 14px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; }.evidence-facts > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 22px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0ef; }.evidence-facts > div:last-child { border: 0; }.evidence-facts svg { color: var(--green); }.evidence-facts strong, .evidence-facts small { display: block; }.evidence-facts strong { font-size: 9px; }.evidence-facts small { margin-top: 2px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 8px; }.evidence-facts em { font-size: 8px; font-style: normal; font-weight: 700; }.fact-warn { color: var(--rose); }.fact-ok { color: var(--green); }.decision-actions { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr; gap: 8px; padding: 0 18px; }.center-button { display: flex; margin: 12px auto 0; }
      .settings-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; }.settings-panel { overflow: hidden; }.panel-muted-icon { color: #85918d; }.setting-row { display: flex; min-height: 76px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; padding: 15px 19px; border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0ef; }.setting-row > span:first-child { min-width: 0; }.setting-row strong, .setting-row small { display: block; }.setting-row strong { font-size: 10px; }.setting-row small { max-width: 380px; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 8px; line-height: 1.4; }.setting-control { display: flex; flex: 0 0 auto; align-items: center; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 5px; }.setting-control input { width: 58px; height: 34px; border: 0; text-align: center; outline: 0; }.setting-control em { padding: 0 9px; border-left: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--muted); font-size: 8px; font-style: normal; }.setting-select { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: var(--green); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; }.toggle { position: relative; width: 36px; height: 20px; flex: 0 0 auto; appearance: none; border-radius: 10px; background: #cbd3d0; cursor: pointer; }.toggle::after { position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; background: white; content: ''; transition: .15s; }.toggle:checked { background: var(--green); }.toggle:checked::after { transform: translateX(16px); }.consent-note, .security-note { display: flex; gap: 9px; margin: 17px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--green); background: var(--green-pale); }.consent-note strong, .consent-note small { display: block; }.consent-note strong { color: var(--ink); font-size: 9px; }.consent-note small { margin-top: 3px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 8px; line-height: 1.4; }
      .profile-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(280px,.65fr) minmax(400px,1.35fr); gap: 16px; }.profile-card { overflow: hidden; }.profile-cover { height: 115px; background: #193c33; }.profile-avatar { position: relative; top: 76px; width: fit-content; margin-left: 22px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: white; }.profile-body { padding: 47px 22px 22px; }.profile-body h2 { font-size: 20px; }.profile-body > p { margin: 4px 0 9px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; }.profile-meta { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; margin-top: 20px; padding-top: 15px; border-top: 1px solid #edf0ef; }.profile-meta small, .profile-meta strong { display: block; }.profile-meta small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 8px; }.profile-meta strong { margin-top: 3px; font-size: 10px; }.device-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 0 18px; padding: 15px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #edf0ef; }.device-icon { display: grid; width: 37px; height: 37px; place-items: center; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--green); background: var(--green-pale); }.device-web { color: var(--blue); background: var(--blue-pale); }.device-row strong, .device-row small { display: block; }.device-row strong { font-size: 10px; }.device-row small { margin-top: 3px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 8px; }.security-note { align-items: flex-start; color: #7e5a1c; background: var(--amber-pale); font-size: 8px; line-height: 1.5; }
      
      @media (max-width: 1100px) {
        .metric-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
        .class-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
        .review-detail-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        .capture-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }.capture-aside { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }.trust-list { grid-column: span 2; }
      }
      
      @media (max-width: 820px) {

Valid for 5 minutes.`);\n}\n\n/** Raised when a student files an attendance query/complaint. */\nexport async function sendQueryRaisedEmail(\n  to: string,\n  studentName: string,\n  trackingId: string,\n  className: string,\n  queryType: string,\n  message: string,\n): Promise<boolean> {\n  const html = emailShell('Query received', `\n    <h1>Attendance query received</h1>\n    <p>Dear <strong>${studentName}</strong>,</p>\n    <p style=\"color:#e2e8f0;\">This student's query has been raised and it will be resolved by the request number.</p>\n    <div class=\"highlight\">\n      <p style=\"margin:0 0 6px;font-size:12px;color:#64748b;\">YOUR REQUEST / TRACKING NUMBER</p>\n      <div class=\"code\">${trackingId}</div>\n    </div>\n    <div class=\"row\"><em>Class</em><strong>${className || '—'}</strong></div>\n    <div class=\"row\"><em>Issue type</em><strong>${queryType.replace(/_/g, ' ')}</strong></div>\n    <div class=\"row\"><em>Details</em><strong>${(message || '—').slice(0, 240)}</strong></div>\n    <div class=\"row\"><em>Status</em><strong>Open · Under review</strong></div>\n    <p style=\"margin-top:18px;\">Keep this request number safe. Class: ${className}. Type: ${queryType}.`;\n  return dispatch(to, `[AttendX] Query raised — Request number ${trackingId}`, html, text);\n}\n\n/** Sent to the student once an admin resolves their query. */\nexport async function sendQueryResolvedEmail(\n  to: string,\n  studentName: string,\n  trackingId: string,\n  status: string,\n  adminNote: string,\n): Promise<boolean> {\n  const resolved = status === 'resolved';\n  const html = emailShell('Query update', `\n    <h1>Query ${resolved ? 'resolved' : 'reviewed'}</h1>\n    <p>Dear <strong>${studentName}</strong>,</p>\n    <p>Your attendance query with request number <strong style=\"color:#34d399;\">${trackingId}</strong> has been <strong>${resolved ? 'resolved' : 'closed as ' + status}</strong>.</p>\n    <div class=\"row\"><em>Request number</em><strong>${trackingId}</strong></div>\n    <div class=\"row\"><em>Status</em><strong style=\"color:${resolved ? '#34d399' : '#f87171'}\">${status.toUpperCase()}</strong></div>\n    <div class=\"row\"><em>Administrator note</em><strong>${adminNote || '—'}</strong></div>\n    <p style=\"margin-top:18px;\">You can view the full record any time in the Attendance Queries section of AttendX. If you believe this decision is incorrect, raise a new query quoting this request number.</p>\n  `);\n  return dispatch(to, `[AttendX] Query ${trackingId} — ${status.toUpperCase()}`, html, `Your AttendX query ${trackingId} has been marked ${status}. }

  "content": "import crypto from 'node:crypto';\nimport { getMongoDb, isMongoActive, execute, getOne, query } from './db.js';\nimport { sendOtpEmail } from './mailer.js';\n\ntype OtpPurpose = 'login' | 'signup' | 'password_reset' | 'general';\n\ninterface OtpRecord {\n  id: string;\n  email: string;\n  code: string;\n  purpose: OtpPurpose;\n  expiresAt: string;\n  createdAt: string;\n  attempts: number;\n  used: boolean;\n}\n\n// ── MongoDB collection for OTPs with TTL cleanup ──────────────────────\nasync function ensureOtpCollection() {\n  if (!isMongoActive()) return;\n  const mongo = getMongoDb();\n  if (!mongo) return;\n  try {\n    const col = mongo.collection('otps');\n    const indexes = await col.indexes();\n    if (!indexes.some((i) => i.name === 'expiresAt_ttl')) {\n      await col.createIndex({ expiresAt: 1 }, { expireAfterSeconds: 60, name: 'expiresAt_ttl' });\n    }\n    await col.createIndex({ email: 1, purpose: 1 });\n  } catch (e) {\n    console.warn('[AttendX OTP] Index init note:', (e as Error).message);\n  }\n}\n\n// ── Simple in-memory rate limiting: max 4 requests / 10 min / email ───\nconst rateMap = new Map<string, number[]>();\nfunction isRateLimited(key: string): boolean {\n  const now = Date.now();\n  const hits = (rateMap.get(key) || []).filter((t) => now - t < 10 * 60 * 1000);\n  if (hits.length >= 4) return true;\n  hits.push(now);\n  rateMap.set(key, hits);\n  return false;\n}\n\n/**\n * Generate a 6-digit numeric OTP, persist it (MongoDB first, SQLite fallback)\n * and deliver it via Gmail SMTP.\n */\nexport async function generateAndSendOtp(\n  email: string,\n  purpose: OtpPurpose = 'login'\n): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {\n  const targetEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();\n  if (!/^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$/.test(targetEmail)) {\n    return { success: false, message: 'A valid email address is required' };\n  }\n  if (isRateLimited(`${targetEmail}:${purpose}`)) {\n    return { success: false, message: 'Too many code requests. Please wait 10 minutes before trying again.' };\n  }\n\n  // Verify the account exists for password resets — never leak validity, but\n  // do not dispatch codes to unknown inboxes either.\n  if (purpose === 'password_reset') {\n    const user = await getOne('SELECT id FROM profiles WHERE lower(email) = ?', [targetEmail]).catch(() => null);\n    if (!user) {\n      return { success: false, message: 'No AttendX account exists for this email address' };\n    }\n  }\n\n  const code = String(Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000));\n  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 5 * 60 * 1000);\n\n  await ensureOtpCollection();\n\n  if (isMongoActive()) {\n    const mongo = getMongoDb();\n    if (mongo) {\n      await mongo.collection('otps').deleteMany({ email: targetEmail, purpose });\n      await mongo.collection('otps').insertOne({\n        email: targetEmail,\n        code,\n        purpose,\n        expiresAt,\n        createdAt: new Date(),\n        attempts: 0,\n        used: false,\n      });\n    }\n  } else {\n    await execute('DELETE FROM password_resets WHERE email = ? AND reason = ?', [targetEmail, `otp_${purpose}`]);\n    await execute(\n      `INSERT INTO password_resets (id, email, temp_password, reason, status, created_at)\n       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'active', ?)`,\n      [crypto.randomUUID(), targetEmail, code, `otp_${purpose}`, new Date().toISOString()]\n    );\n  }\n\n  const delivered = await sendOtpEmail(targetEmail, code, purpose);\n  if (!delivered) {\n    return { success: false, message: 'Could not dispatch the verification email. Please try again shortly.' };\n  }\n  return { success: true, message: 'Verification code sent to your email' };\n}\n\n/**\n * Verify an OTP entered by the user. The code is consumed on success and\n * failed attempts are tracked (max 5) to prevent brute forcing.\n */\nexport async function verifyOtpCode(\n  email: string,\n  code: string,\n  purpose: OtpPurpose = 'login'\n): Promise<boolean> {\n  const targetEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();\n  const targetCode = String(code).trim();\n\n  if (isMongoActive()) {\n    const mongo = getMongoDb();\n    if (!mongo) return false;\n    const record = await mongo.collection('otps').findOne({\n      email: targetEmail,\n      purpose,\n      used: { $ne: true },\n      expiresAt: { $gt: new Date() },\n    });\n    if (!record) return false;\n    if (record.code !== targetCode) {\n      const attempts = Number(record.attempts || 0) + 1;\n      if (attempts >= 5) {\n        await mongo.collection('otps').deleteOne({ _id: record._id });\n      } else {\n        await mongo.collection('otps').updateOne({ _id: record._id }, { $set: { attempts } });\n      }\n      return false;\n    }\n    await mongo.collection('otps').updateOne({ _id: record._id }, { $set: { used: true } });\n    return true;\n  }\n\n  // SQLite fallback (values live in password_resets.temp_password)\n  const row = await getOne(\n    `SELECT id, temp_password AS code FROM password_resets\n     WHERE email = ? AND reason = ? AND status = 'active' AND created_at >= ?`,\n    [targetEmail, `otp_${purpose}`, new Date(Date.now() - 5 * 60 * 1000).toISOString()]\n  );\n  if (!row) return false;\n  if (row.code !== targetCode) return false;\n  await execute(`UPDATE password_resets SET status = 'used' WHERE id = ?`, [row.id]);\n  return true;\n}\n\n/** List active OTP purposes for an email (used by diagnostics/tests). */\nexport async function listActiveOtps(email: string): Promise<OtpRecord[]> {\n  const targetEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();\n  if (isMongoActive()) {\n    const mongo = getMongoDb();\n    if (!mongo) return [];\n    const docs = await mongo.collection('otps').find({ email: targetEmail, used: { $ne: true } }).toArray();\n    return docs.map((doc: any) => ({ ...doc, id: String(doc._id) })) as OtpRecord[];\n  }\n  return query<OtpRecord>(\n    `SELECT id, email, reason AS purpose, created_at AS createdAt FROM password_resets\n     WHERE email = ? AND status = 'active'`,\n    [targetEmail]\n  );\n}\n"
}

{};\n    const allowed = ['resolved', 'rejected', 'open', 'in_review'];\n    const nextStatus = allowed.includes(status) ? status : 'resolved';\n\n    let existing: any = null;\n    if (queriesCol()) {\n      existing = await queriesCol()!.findOne({ id });\n    } else {\n      existing = await getOne('SELECT * FROM attendance_queries WHERE id = ?', [id]);\n    }\n    if (!existing) {\n      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Query not found' });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const now = new Date().toISOString();\n    const resolvedAt = nextStatus === 'resolved' || nextStatus === 'rejected' ? now : null;\n    if (queriesCol()) {\n      await queriesCol()!.updateOne(\n        { id },\n        { $set: { status: nextStatus, admin_note: adminNote || existing.admin_note || '', updated_at: now, resolved_at: resolvedAt } }\n      );\n    } else {\n      await execute(\n        'UPDATE attendance_queries SET status = ?, admin_note = ?, updated_at = ?, resolved_at = ? WHERE id = ?',\n        [nextStatus, adminNote || existing.admin_note || '', now, resolvedAt, id]\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Email the student the outcome, referencing their request number\n    if (existing.student_email && nextStatus !== 'open') {\n      await sendQueryResolvedEmail(\n        existing.student_email,\n        existing.student_name || 'Student',\n        existing.tracking_id,\n        nextStatus,\n        adminNote || '',\n      );\n    }\n\n    res.json({ success: true, status: nextStatus, trackingId: existing.tracking_id });\n  } catch (err) {\n    res.status(500).json({ error: (err as Error).message });\n  }\n}\n"
