Faculty enters the code (handleVerifyFacultyCode) -> 'approved'.\n */\n\nexport function generateInviteCode(): string {\n  return `FAC-${crypto.randomBytes(4).toString('hex').toUpperCase()}`;\n}\n\n// ── GET /api/faculty/pending — list faculty awaiting approval ─────────\nexport async function handleListPendingFaculty(_req: Request, res: Response) {\n  try {\n    if (isMongoActive()) {\n      const docs = await getMongoDb()!\n        .collection('profiles')\n        .find({ role: 'faculty', approval_status: 'pending' })\n        .sort({ created_at: -1 })\n        .toArray();\n      res.json(docs.map((d: any) => {\n        const { _id, ...rest } = d;\n        return { ...rest, id: rest.id || String(_id) };\n      }));\n      return;\n    }\n    const rows = await query(\n      `SELECT id, email, full_name, identifier, department, approval_status, created_at\n       FROM profiles WHERE role = 'faculty' AND approval_status = 'pending'\n       ORDER BY created_at DESC`\n    );\n    res.json(rows);\n  } catch (err) {\n    res.status(500).json({ error: (err as Error).message });\n  }\n}\n\n// ── POST /api/faculty/approve — admin approves and emails the code ────\nexport async function handleApproveFaculty(req: Request, res: Response) {\n  try {\n    const admin = (req as any).user;\n    if (admin.role !== 'admin') {\n      res.status(403).json({ error: 'Only administrators can approve faculty' });\n      return;\n    }\n    const { facultyId } = req.body || {};\n    if (!facultyId) {\n      res.status(400).json({ error: 'facultyId is required' });\n      return;\n    }\n    const faculty = await getOne(\n      `SELECT id, email, full_name, approval_status FROM profiles WHERE id = ? AND role = 'faculty'`,\n      [facultyId]\n    );\n    if (!faculty) {\n      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Faculty account not found' });\n      return;\n    }\n    if (faculty.approval_status === 'approved') {\n      res.status(409).json({ error: 'This faculty account is already approved' });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const code = generateInviteCode();\n    await execute(`UPDATE profiles SET approval_status = 'approved_waiting_code', invite_code = ? WHERE id = ?`, [code, faculty.id]);\n\n    const delivered = await sendFacultyCodeEmail(faculty.email, faculty.full_name, code);\n\n    await execute(\n      `INSERT INTO audit_logs (id, actor_id, action, target_table, target_id, metadata, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,\n      [crypto.randomUUID(), admin.id, 'faculty_approved', 'profiles', faculty.id,\n       JSON.stringify({ email_delivered: delivered, code }), new Date().toISOString()]\n    );\n\n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      code,\n      emailSent: delivered,\n      message: delivered\n        ? 'Faculty approved. The invitation code was emailed to them.'\n        : 'Faculty approved, but the email could not be sent. Share the code manually.',\n    });\n  } catch (err) {\n    res.status(500).json({ error: (err as Error).message });\n  }\n}\n\n// ── POST /api/functions/verify-faculty-code — faculty enters their code\nexport async function handleVerifyFacultyCode(req: Request, res: Response) {\n  try {\n    const user = (req as any).user;\n    const { inviteToken } = req.body || {};\n    if (!inviteToken || !String(inviteToken).trim()) {\n      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invitation code is required' });\n      return;\n    }\n    if (user.role !== 'faculty') {\n      res.status(403).json({ error: 'Only faculty accounts can redeem invitation codes' });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const fresh = await getOne('SELECT invite_code, approval_status FROM profiles WHERE id = ?', [user.id]);\n    if (!fresh) {\n      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Account not found' });\n      return;\n    }\n    if (fresh.approval_status === 'approved') {\n      res.json({ success: true, message: 'Account is already active' });\n      return;\n    }\n    if (fresh.approval_status !== 'approved_waiting_code') {\n      res.status(409).json({ error: 'Your application has not been approved yet' });\n      return;\n    }\n    if (!fresh.invite_code || String(inviteToken).trim().toUpperCase() !== String(fresh.invite_code).toUpperCase()) {\n      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid invitation code. Check the email from AttendX.' });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    await execute(`UPDATE profiles SET approval_status = 'approved', invite_code = NULL WHERE id = ?`, [user.id]);\n    res.json({ success: true, message: 'Faculty account activated' });\n  } catch (err) {\n    res.status(500).json({ error: (err as Error).message });\n  }\n}\n"

      import { useEffect, useId, useState } from 'react'
      import { Html5Qrcode } from 'html5-qrcode'
      import { AlertTriangle, X } from 'lucide-react'
      import { Camera } from '@capacitor/camera'
      import { Capacitor } from '@capacitor/core'
      
      export function QrScannerModal({ title, onResult, onClose }: { title: string; onResult: (value: string) => void; onClose: () => void }) {
        const reactId = useId().replaceAll(':', '')
        const elementId = `attendx-qr-${reactId}`
        const [error, setError] = useState('')
        
        useEffect(() => {
          const scanner = new Html5Qrcode(elementId)
          let isUnmounted = false
          let startPromise: Promise<any> | null = null
      
          const init = async () => {
            if (Capacitor.isNativePlatform()) {
              let perm = await Camera.checkPermissions()
              if (perm.camera !== 'granted') {
                perm = await Camera.requestPermissions()
              }
              if (perm.camera !== 'granted') throw new Error('Camera permission denied')
            }
            
            const cameras = await Html5Qrcode.getCameras()
            if (isUnmounted) return
            if (!cameras.length) throw new Error('No camera was found')
            
            startPromise = scanner.start(
              { facingMode: 'environment' },
              { fps: 10, qrbox: { width: 240, height: 240 } },
              (value) => {
                void scanner.stop().catch(() => undefined).finally(() => scanner.clear())
                onResult(value)
              },
              () => undefined
            )
            
            await startPromise
            if (isUnmounted) {
              void scanner.stop().catch(() => undefined).finally(() => scanner.clear())
            }
          }
      
          init().catch((reason) => {
            if (!isUnmounted) setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : 'Could not start QR scanner')
          })
      
          return () => {
            isUnmounted = true
            if (startPromise) {
              startPromise.then(() => {
                void scanner.stop().catch(() => undefined).finally(() => scanner.clear())
              }).catch(() => undefined)
            }
          }
        }, [elementId, onResult])
        return <div className="camera-modal"><div className="qr-scanner-modal"><button className="icon-button camera-close" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Close scanner"><X/></button><h2>{title}</h2>{error && <div className="inline-error"><AlertTriangle size={16}/>{error}</div>}<div id={elementId} className="qr-reader"/></div></div>
      }
      
      /**
       * Extract join token from various formats:
       * - Raw token string like "JOIN-A1B2C3D4"
       * - URL with ?token=... parameter
       * - Full URL with token embedded in path
       */
      export function extractJoinToken(value: string): string {
        const trimmed = value.trim()
        
        // Check for URL-style token parameter
        const urlMatch = trimmed.match(/[?&]token=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/i)
        if (urlMatch) return urlMatch[1]
        
        // Check for JOIN-<hex> format (case insensitive, 8 chars)
        const joinMatch = trimmed.match(/\b(JOIN-[A-F0-9]{8})\b/i)
        if (joinMatch) return joinMatch[1]
        
        // If it looks like a URL, try to extract the last path segment
        if (trimmed.startsWith('http')) {
          try {
            const url = new URL(trimmed)
            const pathParts = url.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean)
            const last = pathParts[pathParts.length - 1]
            if (last) return last
          } catch {}
        }
        
        // Return as-is (it might be a raw token)
        return trimmed
      }
      
      /**
       * Detect QR code type from scanned value:
       * - 'attendance' for ATXQR tokens (3-part base64url JWT-like format)
       * - 'join' for JOIN-<hex> class invitation tokens
       * - 'unknown' for anything else
       */
      export function detectQrType(value: string): 'attendance' | 'join' | 'unknown' {
        const trimmed = value.trim()
        
        // Check for ATXQR attendance token (3-part dot-separated)
        const parts = trimmed.split('.')
        if (parts.length === 3) {
          try {
            const headerRaw = parts[0].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/')
            const header = JSON.parse(atob(headerRaw))
            if (header.typ === 'ATXQR') return 'attendance'
          } catch {}
        }
        
        // Check for JOIN token pattern
        if (/JOIN-[A-F0-9]+/i.test(trimmed)) return 'join'
        if (/[?&]token=/i.test(trimmed)) return 'join'
        
        return 'unknown'
      }

      import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
      import { Camera as CameraIcon, X } from 'lucide-react'
      import { Camera, CameraDirection, CameraResultType, CameraSource } from '@capacitor/camera'
      import { Capacitor } from '@capacitor/core'
      import { Button } from './ui'
      
      export type LivePhoto = { dataUrl: string; capturedAt: string }
      
      export async function captureNativePhoto(facing: 'user' | 'environment'): Promise<LivePhoto | null> {
        if (!Capacitor.isNativePlatform()) return null
        const photo = await Camera.getPhoto({
          source: CameraSource.Camera,
          resultType: CameraResultType.DataUrl,
          direction: facing === 'user' ? CameraDirection.Front : CameraDirection.Rear,
          quality: 86,
          allowEditing: false,
          saveToGallery: false,
        })
        if (!photo.dataUrl) throw new Error('No camera image was captured')
        return { dataUrl: photo.dataUrl, capturedAt: new Date().toISOString() }
      }
      
      export function CameraCaptureModal({ facing, title, onCapture, onClose }: { facing: 'user'|'environment'; title: string; onCapture: (photo: LivePhoto) => void; onClose: () => void }) {
        const video = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null)
        const stream = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null)
        const [error, setError] = useState('')
        useEffect(() => {
          let mounted = true
          navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: { facingMode: { exact: facing } }, audio: false })
            .catch(() => navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: { facingMode: facing }, audio: false }))
            .then((value) => { 
              stream.current = value
              if (mounted && video.current) { 
                video.current.srcObject = value
                video.current.play().catch(() => undefined)
              } 
            })
            .catch(() => { if (mounted) setError('Camera permission is required. Gallery uploads are not accepted.') })
          return () => {
            mounted = false
            stream.current?.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop())
          }
        }, [facing])
        
        const stopStream = () => stream.current?.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop())
        
        const shoot = () => {
          if (!video.current?.videoWidth) return
          const canvas = document.createElement('canvas')
          canvas.width = video.current.videoWidth; canvas.height = video.current.videoHeight
          canvas.getContext('2d')!.drawImage(video.current, 0, 0)
          stopStream()
          onCapture({ dataUrl: canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', .86), capturedAt: new Date().toISOString() })
        }
        
        const handleClose = () => {
          stopStream()
          onClose()
        }
        
        return <div className="camera-modal"><div className="camera-surface"><button type="button" className="icon-button camera-close" onClick={handleClose} aria-label="Close camera"><X/></button><strong className="camera-title">{title}</strong>{error ? <div className="inline-error">{error}</div> : <video ref={video} playsInline muted/>}<Button type="button" onClick={shoot} disabled={Boolean(error)}><CameraIcon size={18}/>Capture now</Button></div></div>
      }

WHERE id = ?',\n        ['resolved', 'Reset completed from admin dashboard', requestId]);\n      // SQLite queue rows may key the table by email instead of an explicit id.\n      await execute('UPDATE password_resets SET status = ? WHERE user_id = ? AND status = ?',\n        ['resolved', userId, 'pending']);\n    }\n\n    await execute(\n      `INSERT INTO audit_logs (id, actor_id, action, target_table, target_id, metadata, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,\n      [crypto.randomUUID(), admin.id, 'admin_password_reset', 'profiles', userId, '{}', new Date().toISOString()]\n    );\n\n    res.json({ success: true, message: 'Temporary password set. The user must replace it after signing in.' });\n  } catch (err) {\n    res.status(500).json({ error: (err as Error).message });\n  }\n}\n\n// ── POST /api/functions/admin-update-attendance — review queue decision\nexport async function handleAdminUpdateAttendance(req: Request, res: Response) {\n  try {\n    const admin = (req as any).user;\n    if (admin.role !== 'admin') {\n      res.status(403).json({ error: 'Only administrators can review attendance' });\n      return;\n    }\n    const { attendanceId, status, notes } = req.body || {};\n    if (!attendanceId || !['present', 'rejected'].includes(status)) {\n      res.status(400).json({ error: 'attendanceId and a decision of present or rejected are required' });\n      return;\n    }\n    const record = await getOne('SELECT id, student_id FROM attendance_records WHERE id = ?', [attendanceId]);\n    if (!record) {\n      res.status(404).json({ error: 'Attendance record not found' });\n      return;\n    }\n    await execute(\n      'UPDATE attendance_records SET status = ?, rejection_reason = ?, evidence_review_status = ? **🛠 Write File**

```json
{
  "path": "server/src/account.ts",
  "instructions": "OTP password reset completion endpoint + profile face photo upload replacing Supabase storage",
  "content": "import type { Request, Response } from 'express';\nimport crypto from 'node:crypto';\nimport { getOne, execute } from './db.js';\nimport { verifyOtpCode } from './otp.js';\nimport { saveBase64Image } from './auth.js';\n\n/**\n * POST /api/auth/reset-password\n * Body: { email, code, newPassword }\n * Completes the Gmail-SMTP OTP password reset: verify the code, then set the\n * new password and force a password change on next sign-in.\n */\nexport async function handleResetPassword(req: Request, res: Response) {\n  try {\n    const { email, code, newPassword } = req.body || {};\n    if (!email || !code || !newPassword) {\n      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Email, verification code, and new password are required' });\n      return;\n    }\n    if (String(newPassword).length < 12) {\n      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Password must be at least 12 characters' });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const cleanEmail = String(email).trim().toLowerCase();\n    const user = await getOne('SELECT id FROM profiles WHERE lower(email) = ?', [cleanEmail]);\n    if (!user) {\n      res.status(404).json({ error: 'No account found for this email' });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const valid = await verifyOtpCode(cleanEmail, String(code), 'password_reset');\n    if (!valid) {\n      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid or expired verification code' });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const { hashPassword } = await import('./db.js');\n    const hash = hashPassword(String(newPassword));\n    await execute(\n      'UPDATE profiles SET password_hash = ?, must_change_password = 1 WHERE id = ?',\n      [hash, user.id]\n    );\n    await execute(\n      `INSERT INTO audit_logs (id, actor_id, action, target_table, target_id, metadata, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,\n      [crypto.randomUUID(), user.id, 'otp_password_reset', 'profiles', user.id, '{}', new Date().toISOString()]\n    );\n\n    res.json({ success: true, message: 'Password updated. You can now sign in with your new password.' });\n  } catch (err) {\n    res.status(500).json({ error: (err as Error).message });\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * POST /api/profile/photo\n * Body: { dataUrl } — stores the live face capture on disk and links it to the\n * profile (replaces Supabase storage uploads).\n */\nexport async function handleProfilePhoto(req: Request, res: Response) {\n  try {\n    const user = (req as any).user;\n    const { dataUrl } = req.body || {};\n    if (!dataUrl || typeof dataUrl !== 'string' || !dataUrl.startsWith('data:image/')) {\n      res.status(400).json({ error: 'A captured image data URL is required' });\n      return;\n    }\n    const photoPath = saveBase64Image(dataUrl, `profiles/${user.id}`, 'face');\n    if (!photoPath) {\n      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Unsupported image format. Use JPEG, PNG, or WebP.' });\n      return;\n    }\n    await execute('UPDATE profiles SET enrollment_photo_path = ? WHERE id = ?', [photoPath, user.id]);\n\n    // Best-effort face embedding refresh for future verification\n    try {\n      const { extractFaceEmbedding } = await import('./localAi.js');\n      const faceResult = await extractFaceEmbedding(dataUrl);\n      await execute('DELETE FROM face_profiles WHERE user_id = ?', [user.id]);\n      await execute(\n        `INSERT INTO face_profiles (id, user_id, model, model_version, embedding, quality_score, source_photo_path)\n         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,\n        [crypto.randomUUID(), user.id, faceResult.model, faceResult.model_version,\n         JSON.stringify(faceResult.embedding), faceResult.quality_score, photoPath]\n      );\n    } catch {\n      // Verification enrollment is optional; profile photo is already saved.\n    }\n\n    res.json({ success: true, photoPath });\n  } catch (err) {\n    res.status(500).json({ error: (err as Error).message });\n  }\n}\n"
}

  "instructions": "Devtools blocking and AttendX-branded console banner module",
  "content": "/**\n * AttendX console protection.\n *\n * - Disables devtools shortcuts (F12, Ctrl+Shift+I/J/C, Ctrl+U) on web.\n * - Blocks the context menu on web.\n * - Replaces console output with a branded AttendX console.\n * - Detects devtools opening by window size heuristics and blurs the app.\n *\n * Inside the Capacitor APK the WebView has no reachable inspector in release\n * builds, so the size heuristics are skipped there.\n */\n\nconst isNative =\n  typeof window !== 'undefined' &&\n  Boolean((window as any).Capacitor?.isNativePlatform?.());\n\nexport function installConsoleProtection() {\n  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;\n\n  // ── AttendX branded console ──────────────────────────────────────────\n  const brand = [\n    '%cAttendX%c Secure console · v1.0.3',\n    'background:#10b981;color:#04110d;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px 0 0 4px;font-weight:800',\n    'background:#0b1311;color:#94a3b8;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:0 4px 4px 0',\n  ];\n  try {\n    console.log(...brand);\n    console.log(\n      '%cWARNING%c This console is for AttendX diagnostics only. Do not paste or run code from unknown sources.',\n      'color:#ef4444;font-weight:800',\n      'color:inherit',\n    );\n  } catch {\n    /* console unavailable */\n  }\n\n  if (isNative) return;\n\n  // ── Block devtools shortcuts on web ─────────────────────────────────\n  const blockedCombos = (event: KeyboardEvent): boolean => {\n    const key = event.key.toUpperCase();\n    if (event.key === 'F12') return true;\n    if (event.ctrlKey && event.shiftKey && ['I', 'J', 'C'].includes(key)) return true;\n    if (event.metaKey && event.altKey && ['I', 'J', 'C'].includes(key)) return true;\n    if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && key === 'U') return true;\n    return false;\n  };\n\n  window.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {\n    if (blockedCombos(event)) {\n      event.preventDefault();\n      event.stopPropagation();\n      try {\n        console.log('[AttendX] Inspect element is disabled on AttendX web.');\n      } catch {}\n    }\n  }, true);\n\n  window.addEventListener('contextmenu', (event) => {\n    event.preventDefault();\n  });\n\n  // ── Devtools open detection (window size heuristic) ──────────────────\n  const threshold = 170;\n  const check = () => {\n    const wide = window.outerWidth - window.innerWidth > threshold;\n    const tall = window.outerHeight - window.innerHeight > threshold;\n    const open = wide || tall;\n    document.documentElement.style.filter = open ? 'blur(14px)' : '';\n    document.documentElement.style.pointerEvents = open ? 'none' : '';\n  };\n  window.addEventListener('resize', check);\n  check();\n}\n"
}

Actually `people.count` — in my builder, head:true returns { data: [], error: null, count }. But the code destructures `people.count || 0` — I need to check: `const [people, active, ...] = await Promise.all([...])` — each is the full result object { data, error, count }. Then `people.error` and `people.count` — that works since my execute returns count in the result. Good.

      "newString": "async function rows<T>(\n  query: PromiseLike<{ data: T[] | null; error: any }>,\n): Promise<T[]> {\n  const { data, error } = await query;\n  if (error) throw error;\n  return (data as T[]) ?? [];\n}",
      "allowMultiple": false
    },
    {
      "oldString": "async function loadClasses(role: Role, userId: string): Promise<DbClass[]> {\n  if (!supabase) throw new Error(\"Supabase is not configured\");\n  if (role === \"admin\")\n    return rows<DbClass>(supabase.from(\"classes\").select(\"*, class_schedules(*)\").order(\"name\"));\n  if (role === \"faculty\")\n    return rows<DbClass>(\n      supabase\n        .from(\"classes\")\n        .select(\"*, class_schedules(*)\")\n        .eq(\"faculty_id\", userId)\n        .eq(\"is_active\", true)\n        .order(\"name\"),\n    );\n  const enrollments = await rows<any>(\n    supabase\n      .from(\"enrollments\")\n      .select(\"class_id\")\n      .eq(\"student_id\", userId)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\"),\n  );\n  const ids = enrollments.map((item) => item.class_id);\n  return ids.length\n    ? rows<DbClass>(\n        supabase\n          .from(\"classes\")\n          .select(\"*, class_schedules(*)\")\n          .in(\"id\", ids)\n          .eq(\"is_active\", true)\n          .eq(\"publication_status\", \"published\")\n          .order(\"name\"),\n      )\n    : [];\n}\n\nasync function loadFacultyBatches(userId: string): Promise<any[]> {\n  if (!supabase) throw new Error(\"Supabase is not configured\");\n  const [assigned, owned] = await Promise.all([\n    rows<any>(\n      supabase\n        .from(\"faculty_assignments\")\n        .select(\"batch_id,batches(*)\")\n        .eq(\"faculty_id\", userId)\n        .eq(\"is_active\", true),\n    ),\n    rows<any>(\n      supabase\n        .from(\"batches\")\n        .select(\"*\")\n        .eq(\"created_by\", userId)\n        .eq(\"is_active\", true),\n    ),\n  ]);\n  const combined = [\n    ...assigned.map((item) => item.batches).filter(Boolean),\n    ...owned,\n  ];\n  return Array.from(new Map(combined.map((item) => [item.id, item])).values());\n}\n\nasync function loadAttendance(\n  role: Role,\n  userId: string,\n  limit = 50,\n  filters?: { date?: string; month?: string; classId?: string }\n): Promise<DbRecord[]> {\n  if (!supabase) throw new Error(\"Supabase is not configured\");\n  let query = supabase\n    .from(\"attendance_records\")\n    .select(\n      \"*,attendance_sessions!inner(id,class_id,started_at,center_lat,center_lng,geofence_radius_m,classes!inner(name,code,faculty_id)),profiles!attendance_records_student_id_fkey(full_name,identifier)\",\n    )\n    .order(\"marked_at\", { ascending: false })\n    .limit(limit);\n    \n  if (role === \"student\") {\n    query = query.eq(\"student_id\", userId);\n  } else if (role === \"faculty\") {\n    query = query.eq(\"attendance_sessions.classes.faculty_id\", userId);\n  }\n\n  if (filters?.classId) {\n    query = query.eq(\"attendance_sessions.class_id\", filters.classId);\n  }\n  \n  if (filters?.date) {\n    const start = new Date(filters.date);\n    const end = new Date(filters.date);\n    end.setDate(end.getDate() + 1);\n    query = query.gte(\"marked_at\", start.toISOString()).lt(\"marked_at\", end.toISOString());\n  } else if (filters?.month) {\n    const start = new Date(filters.month + \"-01\");\n    const end = new Date(start);\n    end.setMonth(end.getMonth() + 1);\n    query = query.gte(\"marked_at\", start.toISOString()).lt(\"marked_at\", end.toISOString());\n  }\n\n  return rows<DbRecord>(query);\n}",
      "newString": "async function loadClasses(role: Role, userId: string): Promise<DbClass[]> {\n  if (role === \"admin\")\n    return rows<DbClass>(supabase.from(\"classes\").select(\"*\").order(\"name\"));\n  if (role === \"faculty\")\n    return rows<DbClass>(\n      supabase\n        .from(\"classes\")\n        .select(\"*\")\n        .eq(\"faculty_id\", userId)\n        .order(\"name\"),\n    );\n  const enrollments = await rows<any>(\n    supabase\n      .from(\"enrollments\")\n      .select(\"class_id\")\n      .eq(\"student_id\", userId)\n      .eq(\"status\", \"active\"),\n  );\n  const ids = enrollments.map((item) => item.class_id);\n  return ids.length\n    ? rows<DbClass>(\n        supabase\n          .from(\"classes\")\n          .select(\"*\")\n          .in(\"id\", ids)\n          .order(\"name\"),\n      )\n    : [];\n}\n\nasync function loadFacultyBatches(userId: string): Promise<any[]> {\n  const [assigned, owned] = await Promise.all([\n    rows<any>(\n      supabase\n        .from(\"faculty_assignments\")\n        .select(\"*\")\n        .eq(\"faculty_id\", userId),\n    ),\n    rows<any>(\n      supabase\n        .from(\"batches\")\n        .select(\"*\")\n        .eq(\"created_by\", userId),\n    ),\n  ]);\n  const combined = [\n    ...assigned.map((item) => item.batches).filter(Boolean),\n    ...owned,\n  ];\n  return Array.from(new Map(combined.map((item) => [item.id, item])).values());\n}\n\n/**\n * Load attendance records. The AttendX API enriches every record with its\n * session and class information, so filters that used embedded-resource\n * syntax are applied client-side here.\n */\nasync function loadAttendance(\n  role: Role,\n  userId: string,\n  limit = 50,\n  filters?: { date?: string; month?: string; classId?: string },\n): Promise<DbRecord[]> {\n  let records = await rows<DbRecord>(\n    supabase\n      .from(\"attendance_records\")\n      .select(\"*\")\n      .order(\"marked_at\", { ascending: false })\n      .limit(300),\n  );\n\n  if (role === \"student\") {\n    records = records.filter((r) => r.student_id === userId);\n  } else if (role === \"faculty\") {\n    records = records.filter(\n      (r) => r.attendance_sessions?.classes?.faculty_id === userId,\n    );\n  }\n  if (filters?.classId) {\n    records = records.filter(\n      (r) => r.attendance_sessions?.class_id === filters.classId,\n    );\n  }\n  if (filters?.date) {\n    const start = new Date(filters.date);\n    const end = new Date(filters.date);\n    end.setDate(end.getDate() + 1);\n    records = records.filter((r) => {\n      const t = new Date(r.marked_at).getTime();\n      return t >= start.getTime() && t < end.getTime();\n    });\n  } else if (filters?.month) {\n    const start = new Date(filters.month + \"-01\");\n    const end = new Date(start);\n    end.setMonth(end.getMonth() + 1);\n    records = records.filter((r) => {\n      const t = new Date(r.marked_at).getTime();\n      return t >= start.getTime() && t < end.getTime();\n    });\n  }\n  return records.slice(0, limit);\n}",

}\n                }\n            } catch (Exception ignored) {}\n\n            // Flag the well-known fake GPS apps if enabled as mock providers\n            try {\n                String mockApp = - path: src\lib\platform.ts
  content: |
      import { Capacitor } from '@capacitor/core'
      
      /**
       * Returns true only when the UI is running inside the packaged Capacitor app.
       *
       * Capacitor normally exposes the native platform before the first React render.
       * Some Android WebViews initialise that bridge a moment later, however, so the
       * HTTPS localhost origin used by Capacitor is kept as a narrow fallback.  A
       * regular Android browser on the deployed web site never meets that fallback.
       */
      export function isNativeApp(): boolean {
        if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false
      
        const platform = Capacitor.getPlatform()
        if (platform === 'android' || platform === 'ios' || Capacitor.isNativePlatform()) {
          return true
        }
      
        const bridge = (window as typeof window & { Capacitor?: typeof Capacitor }).Capacitor
        const bridgePlatform = bridge?.getPlatform?.()
        if (bridgePlatform === 'android' || bridgePlatform === 'ios' || bridge?.isNativePlatform?.()) {
          return true
        }
      
        const isAndroid = /\bAndroid\b/i.test(navigator.userAgent)
        const isCapacitorAssetOrigin =
          window.location.protocol === 'https:' &&
          (window.location.hostname === 'localhost' || window.location.hostname === '127.0.0.1')
      
        return isAndroid && isCapacitorAssetOrigin
      }
      
  referencedBy: {}
```

Any Android WebView user agent (\"; wv)\" token) — a regular browser on\n *     the deployed website never carries that token, so the download link\n *     stays visible there while disappearing inside the installed app.\n */\nexport function isNativeApp(): boolean {\n  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false\n\n  const platform = Capacitor.getPlatform()\n  if (platform === 'android' || platform === 'ios' || Capacitor.isNativePlatform()) {\n    return true\n  }\n\n  const bridge = (window as typeof window & { Capacitor?: typeof Capacitor }).Capacitor\n  const bridgePlatform = bridge?.getPlatform?.()\n  if (bridgePlatform === 'android' || bridgePlatform === 'ios' || bridge?.isNativePlatform?.()) {\n    return true\n  }\n\n  // Capacitor serves the bundled assets from an https://localhost origin.\n  const isCapacitorAssetOrigin =\n    window.location.protocol === 'https:' &&\n    (window.location.hostname === 'localhost' || window.location.hostname === '127.0.0.1')\n\n  // Any Android WebView (the token \"; wv)\" in the user agent) is the packaged\n  // app, never a user's browser. This catches devices where the Capacitor\n  // bridge initialises late or is otherwise unavailable.\n  const isWebView = /\\bwv\\b/.test(navigator.userAgent)\n\n  const isAndroid = /\\bAndroid\\b/i.test(navigator.userAgent)\n\n  return (isAndroid && isCapacitorAssetOrigin) || isWebView\n}\n"
}

{
  "path": "server/src/appUpdate.ts",
  "instructions": "App update metadata endpoint resolving the latest APK from GitHub Releases with env overrides and caching",
  "content": "import type { Request, Response } from 'express';\n\n/**\n * App update service.\n *\n * The Android APK is published as a GitHub Releases asset. The client asks\n * this endpoint for the latest version; when a newer versionCode is available\n * the app shows an update notice and the admin mass-mail includes the link.\n *\n * Resolution order:\n *  1. ATX_LATEST_APK_URL / ATX_LATEST_VERSION / ATX_LATEST_VERSION_CODE env\n *     overrides (explicit pinning without a GitHub round-trip).\n *  2. GitHub Releases \"latest\" for ATX_GITHUB_REPO (default repo below),\n *     picking the first .apk asset.\n *\n * The GitHub lookup is cached in memory for 10 minutes.\n */\n\nconst GITHUB_REPO = process.env.ATX_GITHUB_REPO || 'Mohitsharma-2007/AttendX';\nconst FALLBACK_URL = `https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPO}/releases/latest`;\nconst CACHE_TTL_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000;\n\ninterface LatestRelease {\n  version: string;\n  versionCode: number;\n  apkUrl: string;\n  releasePage: string;\n  releaseNotes: string;\n  publishedAt: string | null;\n}\n\nlet cache: { at: number; data: LatestRelease } | null = null;\n\nfunction pickApkAsset(assets: any[]): any | null {\n  return (assets || []).find((a) => /\\.apk$/i.test(a.name || '')) || null;\n}\n\nasync function fetchFromGitHub(): Promise<LatestRelease | null> {\n  try {\n    const headers: Record<string, string> = { 'User-Agent': 'AttendX-Update-Service' };\n    if (process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN) headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN}`;\n    const res = await fetch(`https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_REPO}/releases/latest`, {\n      headers,\n      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),\n    });\n    if (!res.ok) return null;\n    const data: any = await res.json();\n    const apk = pickApkAsset(data.assets || []);\n    const tag: string = data.tag_name || data.name || '';\n    return {\n      version: (apk?.name?.match(/v?(\\d+\\.\\d+\\.\\d+)/)?.[1]) || tag.replace(/^v/, '') || tag,\n      versionCode: Number(/v?(\\d+)/.exec(tag)?.[1] || 0),\n      apkUrl: apk?.browser_download_url || FALLBACK_URL,\n      releasePage: data.html_url || FALLBACK_URL,\n      releaseNotes: data.body || '',\n      publishedAt: data.published_at || null,\n    };\n  } catch {\n    return null;\n  }\n}\n\nfunction fromEnv(): LatestRelease | null {\n  const url = process.env.ATX_LATEST_APK_URL;\n  const version = process.env.ATX_LATEST_VERSION;\n  if (!url || !version) return null;\n  return {\n    version,\n    versionCode: Number(process.env.ATX_LATEST_VERSION_CODE || 0),\n    apkUrl: url,\n    releasePage: url,\n    releaseNotes: process.env.ATX_LATEST_NOTES || '',\n    publishedAt: null,\n  };\n}\n\nexport async function handleAppLatest(_req: Request, res: Response) {\n  try {\n    if (cache && Date.now() - cache.at < CACHE_TTL_MS) {\n      res.json({ ...cache.data, cached: true });\n      return;\n    }\n    const data = fromEnv() || (await fetchFromGitHub());\n    if (!data) {\n      // No release metadata available — still hand back the releases page so\n      // the client can offer a manual check.\n      res.json({\n        version: null,\n        versionCode: 0,\n        apkUrl: FALLBACK_URL,\n        releasePage: FALLBACK_URL,\n        releaseNotes: '',\n        publishedAt: null,\n      });\n      return;\n    }\n    cache = { at: Date.now(), data };\n    res.json({ ...data, cached: false });\n  } catch (err) {\n    res.status(500).json({ error: (err as Error).message });\n  }\n}\n"
}

{
  "path": "server/src/massMail.ts",
  "instructions": "Admin mass-mail module: sends notice to active users via SMTP with APK update link, audit logged, campaign recorded",
  "content": "import type { Request, Response } from 'express';\nimport crypto from 'node:crypto';\nimport { query, execute, getMongoDb, isMongoActive } from './db.js';\nimport { transporter, FROM_HEADER, smtpConfigured, ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL } from './mailer.js';\n\n/**\n * Admin mass-mail system.\n *\n * Sends a notice to every active user (optionally filtered by role) using the\n * Gmail SMTP transport, with the latest APK download link appended so users\n * can update the Android app straight from the email. Every campaign is\n * recorded in the audit log with recipient counts.\n */\n\nfunction apkLinkHtml(apkUrl: string, version: string | null): string {\n  return `\n    <div class=\"highlight\">\n      <p style=\"margin:0 0 6px;font-size:12px;color:#64748b;\">${version ? `ATTENDX ANDROID APP · v${version}` : 'ATTENDX ANDROID APP'}</p>\n      <p style=\"margin:0 0 12px;color:#e2e8f0;font-size:14px;\">Update or install the latest Android app:</p>\n      <a href=\"${apkUrl}\" style=\"display:inline-block;background:#10b981;color:#04110d;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;padding:12px 26px;border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none;\">Download / Update APK</a>\n      <p style=\"margin:10px 0 0;font-size:11px;color:#64748b;\">If the button does not work, open: ${apkUrl}</p>\n    </div>\n  `;\n}\n\nfunction noticeShell(title: string, bodyHtml: string, apkUrl: string, version: string | null, includeApk: boolean): string {\n  return `\n    <!DOCTYPE html>\n    <html>\n    <head>\n      <meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n      <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0\">\n      <style>\n        body { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; background-color: #0b1311; color: #f1f5f9; margin: 0; padding: 24px; }\n        .card { max-width: 540px; margin: 0 auto; background: #131d1b; border: 1px solid #223733; border-radius: 14px; padding: 32px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }\n        .logo { font-weight: 800; font-size: 20px; color: #10b981; margin-bottom: 24px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; }\n        .logo span { color: #f1f5f9; }\n        h1 { font-size: 20px; margin: 0 0 12px; color: #ffffff; }\n        p { font-size: 14px; color: #94a3b8; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0 0 14px; }\n        .msg { background: #0b1311; border: 1px solid #1e293b; border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px; color: #e2e8f0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; white-space: pre-wrap; }\n        .highlight { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12), rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.12)); border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.35); border-radius: 10px; padding: 18px; text-align: center; margin: 22px 0; }\n        .footer { border-top: 1px solid #1e293b; padding-top: 16px; margin-top: 24px; font-size: 12px; color: #64748b; text-align: center; }\n      </style>\n    </head>\n    <body>\n      <div class=\"card\">\n        <div class=\"logo\"><span>Attend</span>X</div>\n        <h1>${title}</h1>\n        <p>An official notice from your institution's administration:</p>\n        <div class=\"msg\">${bodyHtml}</div>\n        ${includeApk ? apkLinkHtml(apkUrl, version) : ''}\n        <div class=\"footer\">AttendX · Institutional attendance infrastructure</div>\n      </div>\n    </body>\n    </html>\n  `;\n}\n\n// ── GET /api/admin/mass-email/recipients — preview recipient count ────\nexport async function handleMassEmailRecipients(req: Request, res: Response) {\n  try {\n    const admin = (req as any).user;\n    if (admin.role !== 'admin') {\n      res.status(403).json({ error: 'Only administrators can send notices' });\n      return;\n    }\n    const role = String((req.query.role as string) || 'all');\n    const params: any[] = [];\n    let where = 'is_active IN (1, true)';\n    if (role !== 'all') {\n      where += ' AND role = ?';\n      params.push(role);\n    }\n    const rows = await query(\n      `SELECT email, full_name, role FROM profiles WHERE ${where} ORDER BY role, full_name`,\n      params\n    );\n    res.json({ count: rows.length, recipients: rows.slice(0, 500) });\n  } catch (err) {\n    res.status(500).json({ error: (err as Error).message });\n  }\n}\n\n// ── POST /api/admin/mass-email — send the notice ──────────────────────\nexport async function handleMassEmail(req: Request, res: Response) {\n  try {\n    const admin = (req as any).user;\n    if (admin.role !== 'admin') {\n      res.status(403).json({ error: 'Only administrators can send notices' });\n      return;\n    }\n    if (!smtpConfigured) {\n      res.status(503).json({ error: 'SMTP is not configured on the server. Set SMTP_USER and SMTP_PASS.' });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const { subject, message, role, includeApkLink, apkUrl, apkVersion } = req.body || {};\n    if (!subject || !message) {\n      res.status(400).json({ error: 'Subject and message are required' });\n      return;\n    }\n    const targetRole = role && role !== 'all' ? String(role) : 'all';\n    const withApk = Boolean(includeApkLink);\n    const link = String(apkUrl || `https://github.com/Mohitsharma-2007/AttendX/releases/latest`);\n\n    const params: any[] = [];\n    let where = 'is_active IN (1, true)';\n    if (targetRole !== 'all') {\n      where += ' AND role = ?';\n      params.push(targetRole);\n    }\n    const recipients = await query(\n      `SELECT email, full_name FROM profiles WHERE ${where}`,\n      params\n    );\n    if (!recipients.length) {\n      res.status(404).json({ error: 'No active recipients match this filter' });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const html = noticeShell(\n      String(subject),\n      String(message).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;'),\n      link,\n      apkVersion || null,\n      withApk,\n    );\n    const text = `${subject}\\n\\n${message}${withApk ? `\\n\\nDownload / update the Android app: ${link}` : ''}`;\n\n    let sent = 0;\n    let failed = 0;\n    const failures: string[] = [];\n    // Small batches keep Gmail SMTP happy (anti-burst pacing).\n    for (const person of recipients) {\n      if (!person?.email) continue;\n      try {\n        await transporter.sendMail({\n          from: FROM_HEADER,\n          to: person.email,\n          subject: `[AttendX] ${subject}`,\n          html,\n          text,\n        });\n        sent += 1;\n      } catch {\n        failed += 1;\n        if (failures.length < 10) failures.push(person.email);\n      }\n    }\n\n    const campaignId = crypto.randomUUID();\n    await execute(\n      `INSERT INTO audit_logs (id, actor_id, action, target_table, target_id, metadata, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,\n      [campaignId, admin.id, 'mass_email_sent', 'profiles', null,\n       JSON.stringify({ subject, role: targetRole, recipients: recipients.length, sent, failed, includeApkLink: withApk }),\n       new Date().toISOString()]\n    );\n\n    // Record the campaign for the admin panel history (Mongo primary).\n    if (isMongoActive()) {\n      await getMongoDb()!.collection('email_campaigns').insertOne({\n        id: campaignId,\n        subject,\n        role: targetRole,\n        recipients: recipients.length,\n        sent,\n        failed,\n        include_apk_link: withApk,\n        sent_by: admin.email,\n        created_at: new Date().toISOString(),\n      });\n    }\n\n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      campaignId,\n      recipients: recipients.length,\n      sent,\n      failed,\n      failures,\n    });\n  } catch (err) {\n    res.status(500).json({ error: (err as Error).message });\n  }\n}\n\n// Re-export so the admin panel can surface the notify address if needed.\nexport { ADMIN_NOTIFY_EMAIL };\n"
}

  "content": "/**\n * Bundled app identity. Bump these together with android/app/build.gradle\n * (versionName / versionCode) on every release.\n */\nexport const APP_VERSION = '1.0.3';\nexport const APP_VERSION_CODE = 3;\n\nexport interface AppUpdateInfo {\n  currentVersion: string;\n  latestVersion: string | null;\n  latestVersionCode: number;\n  apkUrl: string;\n  releasePage: string;\n  releaseNotes: string;\n  updateAvailable: boolean;\n}\n\n/**\n * Ask the AttendX server for the latest published APK. Compares version codes\n * so an outdated install can surface the update notice.\n */\nexport async function checkForUpdate(serverUrl: string): Promise<AppUpdateInfo> {\n  const fallback: AppUpdateInfo = {\n    currentVersion: APP_VERSION,\n    latestVersion: null,\n    latestVersionCode: 0,\n    apkUrl: `${serverUrl}/api/app/latest`,\n    releasePage: 'https://github.com/Mohitsharma-2007/AttendX/releases/latest',\n    releaseNotes: '',\n    updateAvailable: false,\n  };\n  try {\n    const res = await fetch(`${serverUrl}/api/app/latest`, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000) });\n    if (!res.ok) return fallback;\n    const data = await res.json();\n    const latestCode = Number(data.versionCode || 0);\n    return {\n      currentVersion: APP_VERSION,\n      latestVersion: data.version || null,\n      latestVersionCode: latestCode,\n      apkUrl: data.apkUrl || fallback.apkUrl,\n      releasePage: data.releasePage || fallback.releasePage,\n      releaseNotes: data.releaseNotes || '',\n      updateAvailable: latestCode > APP_VERSION_CODE,\n    };\n  } catch {\n    return fallback;\n  }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';\nimport { RefreshCw, X, ArrowUpCircle } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { isNativeApp } from '../lib/platform';\nimport { getLocalServerUrl } from '../lib/apiClient';\nimport { checkForUpdate, type AppUpdateInfo } from '../lib/appVersion';\n\nconst DISMISS_KEY = 'attendx_update_dismissed_version';\n\n/**\n * Update notice for the Android app. Polls the server once per session (and\n * whenever the app resumes) and shows a banner when a newer versionCode is\n * published. The user can open the APK link directly — updating happens by\n * downloading the new release, exactly like the mass-mail button.\n */\nexport function UpdateBanner() {\n  const [info, setInfo] = useState<AppUpdateInfo | null>(null);\n  const [dismissed, setDismissed] = useState<string | null>(\n    typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem(DISMISS_KEY) : null,\n  );\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!isNativeApp()) return; // web users are always current\n    let cancelled = false;\n\n    const verify = async () => {\n      const result = await checkForUpdate(getLocalServerUrl());\n      if (!cancelled) setInfo(result);\n    };\n    void verify();\n\n    const onFocus = () => void verify();\n    window.addEventListener('focus', onFocus);\n    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {\n      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') void verify();\n    });\n    return () => {\n      cancelled = true;\n      window.removeEventListener('focus', onFocus);\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  if (!info?.updateAvailable || !info.latestVersion) return null;\n  if (dismissed === info.latestVersion) return null;\n\n  const dismiss = () => {\n    localStorage.setItem(DISMISS_KEY, info.latestVersion!);\n    setDismissed(info.latestVersion);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div\n      style={{\n        display: 'flex',\n        alignItems: 'center',\n        gap: '0.75rem',\n        margin: '0 0 1rem',\n        padding: '0.85rem 1rem',\n        border: '1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.35)',\n        borderRadius: '8px',\n        background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12), rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.08))',\n      }}\n    >\n      <ArrowUpCircle size={22} style={{ color: '#10b981', flexShrink: 0 }} />\n      <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>\n        <strong style={{ display: 'block', fontSize: '0.9rem' }}>\n          Update available — v{info.latestVersion}\n        </strong>\n        <small style={{ display: 'block', color: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: '0.78rem' }}>\n          You are on v{info.currentVersion}. Tap update to download the latest APK.\n        </small>\n      </div>\n      <a\n        href={info.apkUrl}\n        target=\"_blank\"\n        rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\n        style={{\n          display: 'inline-flex',\n          alignItems: 'center',\n          gap: '0.35rem',\n          padding: '0.45rem 0.9rem',\n          borderRadius: '7px',\n          background: '#10b981',\n          color: '#04110d',\n          fontSize: '0.8rem',\n          fontWeight: 700,\n          textDecoration: 'none',\n          flexShrink: 0,\n        }}\n      >\n        <RefreshCw size={14} />\n        Update\n      </a>\n      <button\n        className=\"icon-button\"\n        onClick={dismiss}\n        aria-label=\"Dismiss update notice\"\n        style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}\n      >\n        <X size={16} />\n      </button>\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"
}

res.json() : Promise.reject(new Error('Failed'))))\n      .then((data) => setRecipientCount(data.count))\n      .catch(() => setRecipientCount(null));\n  }, [role]);\n\n  const send = async () => {\n    if (!subject.trim() || !message.trim()) {\n      setResult({ ok: false, text: 'Add a subject and a message before sending.' });\n      return;\n    }\n    setSending(true);\n    setResult(null);\n    try {\n      const token = localStorage.getItem('attendx_auth_token') || '';\n      const res = await fetch(`${getLocalServerUrl()}/api/admin/mass-email`, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          subject: subject.trim(),\n          message: message.trim(),\n          role,\n          includeApkLink: includeApk,\n        }),\n      });\n      const data = await res.json();\n      if (!res.ok || !data.success) throw new Error(data.error || 'Could not send the notice');\n      setResult({\n        ok: true,\n        text: `Notice sent to ${data.sent} of ${data.recipients} recipients${data.failed ? ` (${data.failed} failed)` : ''}.`,\n      });\n      setSubject('');\n      setMessage('');\n    } catch (err) {\n      setResult({ ok: false, text: (err as Error).message });\n    }\n    setSending(false);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <section className=\"panel\">\n      <div className=\"panel-head\">\n        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.6rem' }}>\n          <Mail size={20} />\n          <h2>Mass Mail — Notice to Users</h2>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      <p style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', marginBottom: '1rem', fontSize: '0.9rem' }}>\n        Send an official email notice to every active user. Include the latest\n        Android APK link so everyone can update the app straight from the mail.\n      </p>\n      <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '0.75rem' }}>\n        <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>\n          <label className=\"field-label\" style={{ marginBottom: 0, flex: 1, minWidth: '180px' }}>\n            Audience\n            <select className=\"text-input\" value={role} onChange={(e) => setRole(e.target.value)}>\n              <option value=\"all\">Everyone (students + faculty)</option>\n              <option value=\"student\">Students only</option>\n              <option value=\"faculty\">Faculty only</option>\n            </select>\n          </label>\n          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-end', gap: '0.4rem', paddingBottom: '17px', fontSize: '0.85rem', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>\n            <Users size={16} />\n            <span>{recipientCount === null ? '…' : `${recipientCount} recipient${recipientCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}`}</span>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n        <label className=\"field-label\" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>\n          Subject\n          <input\n            className=\"text-input\"\n            value={subject}\n            onChange={(e) => setSubject(e.target.value)}\n            placeholder=\"New app update available — please update AttendX\"\n          />\n        </label>\n        <label className=\"field-label\" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>\n          Message\n          <textarea\n            className=\"text-input\"\n            style={{ minHeight: '110px', paddingTop: '10px', resize: 'vertical' }}\n            value={message}\n            onChange={(e) => setMessage(e.target.value)}\n            placeholder=\"Dear users, a new version of the AttendX Android app is available. Please update using the button below…\"\n          />\n        </label>\n        <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.6rem', fontSize: '0.88rem', cursor: 'pointer' }}>\n          <input\n            type=\"checkbox\"\n            className=\"toggle\"\n            checked={includeApk}\n            onChange={(e) => setIncludeApk(e.target.checked)}\n          />\n          Attach the latest APK download link to this notice\n        </label>\n        <div>\n          <Button onClick={send} disabled={sending}>\n            <Send size={16} />\n            {sending ? 'Sending…' : 'Send notice to everyone'}\n          </Button>\n        </div>\n      </div>\n      {result && (\n        <div\n          style={{\n            marginTop: '0.9rem',\n            padding: '0.6rem 0.9rem',\n            borderRadius: '6px',\n            display: 'flex',\n            alignItems: 'center',\n            gap: '0.5rem',\n            fontSize: '0.88rem',\n            backgroundColor: result.ok ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)',\n            color: result.ok ? '#22c55e' : '#ef4444',\n          }}\n        >\n          {result.ok ? <CheckCircle2 size={16} /> : <AlertCircle size={16} />}\n          {result.text}\n        </div>\n      )}\n    </section>\n  );\n}\n\nexport function ServerAndSyncSettings() {\n  const [serverUrl, setServerUrlState] = useState('');\n  const [testing, setTesting] = useState(false);\n  const [testResult, setTestResult] = useState<{ ok: boolean; message: string } | null>(null);\n  const [exporting, setExporting] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    setServerUrlState(getLocalServerUrl());\n  }, []);",

  content: |
      import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
      import { Server, Database, Download, CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, RefreshCw, ShieldCheck, Mail, Users, Send } from 'lucide-react';
      import { Button } from './ui';
      import { getLocalServerUrl, setLocalServerUrl } from '../lib/apiClient';
      
      function MassMailPanel() {
        const [subject, setSubject] = useState('');
        const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
        const [role, setRole] = useState('all');
        const [includeApk, setIncludeApk] = useState(true);
        const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
        const [result, setResult] = useState<{ ok: boolean; text: string } | null>(null);
        const [recipientCount, setRecipientCount] = useState<number | null>(null);
      
        useEffect(() => {
          const token = localStorage.getItem('attendx_auth_token') || '';
          fetch(`${getLocalServerUrl()}/api/admin/mass-email/recipients?role=${role}`, {
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
          })
            .then((res) => (res.ok ? res.json() : Promise.reject(new Error('Failed'))))
            .then((data) => setRecipientCount(data.count))
            .catch(() => setRecipientCount(null));
        }, [role]);
      
        const send = async () => {
          if (!subject.trim() || !message.trim()) {
            setResult({ ok: false, text: 'Add a subject and a message before sending.' });
            return;
          }
          setSending(true);
          setResult(null);
          try {
            const token = localStorage.getItem('attendx_auth_token') || '';
            const res = await fetch(`${getLocalServerUrl()}/api/admin/mass-email`, {
              method: 'POST',
              headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
              body: JSON.stringify({
                subject: subject.trim(),
                message: message.trim(),
                role,
                includeApkLink: includeApk,
              }),
            });
            const data = await res.json();
            if (!res.ok || !data.success) throw new Error(data.error || 'Could not send the notice');
            setResult({
              ok: true,
              text: `Notice sent to ${data.sent} of ${data.recipients} recipients${data.failed ? ` (${data.failed} failed)` : ''}.`,
            });
            setSubject('');
            setMessage('');
          } catch (err) {
            setResult({ ok: false, text: (err as Error).message });
          }
          setSending(false);
        };
      
        return (
          <section className="panel">
            <div className="panel-head">
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.6rem' }}>
                <Mail size={20} />
                <h2>Mass Mail — Notice to Users</h2>
              </div>
            </div>
            <p style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', marginBottom: '1rem', fontSize: '0.9rem' }}>
              Send an official email notice to every active user. Include the latest
              Android APK link so everyone can update the app straight from the mail.
            </p>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '0.75rem' }}>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                <label className="field-label" style={{ marginBottom: 0, flex: 1, minWidth: '180px' }}>
                  Audience
                  <select className="text-input" value={role} onChange={(e) => setRole(e.target.value)}>
                    <option value="all">Everyone (students + faculty)</option>
                    <option value="student">Students only</option>
                    <option value="faculty">Faculty only</option>
                  </select>
                </label>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-end', gap: '0.4rem', paddingBottom: '17px', fontSize: '0.85rem', color: 'var(--muted)' }}>
                  <Users size={16} />
                  <span>{recipientCount === null ? '…' : `${recipientCount} recipient${recipientCount === 1 ? '' : 's'}`}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <label className="field-label" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>
                Subject
                <input
                  className="text-input"
                  value={subject}
                  onChange={(e) => setSubject(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="New app update available — please update AttendX"
                />
              </label>
              <label className="field-label" style={{ marginBottom: 0 }}>
                Message
                <textarea
                  className="text-input"
                  style={{ minHeight: '110px', paddingTop: '10px', resize: 'vertical' }}
                  value={message}
                  onChange={(e) => setMessage(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Dear users, a new version of the AttendX Android app is available. Please update using the button below…"
                />
              </label>
              <label style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.6rem', fontSize: '0.88rem', cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  className="toggle"
                  checked={includeApk}
                  onChange={(e) => setIncludeApk(e.target.checked)}
                />
                Attach the latest APK download link to this notice
              </label>
              <div>
                <Button onClick={send} disabled={sending}>
                  <Send size={16} />
                  {sending ? 'Sending…' : 'Send notice to everyone'}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
            {result && (
              <div
                style={{
                  marginTop: '0.9rem',
                  padding: '0.6rem 0.9rem',
                  borderRadius: '6px',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  gap: '0.5rem',
                  fontSize: '0.88rem',
                  backgroundColor: result.ok ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)',
                  color: result.ok ? '#22c55e' : '#ef4444',
                }}
              >
                {result.ok ? <CheckCircle2 size={16} /> : <AlertCircle size={16} />}
                {result.text}
              </div>
            )}
          </section>
        );
      }
      
      export function ServerAndSyncSettings() {
        const [serverUrl, setServerUrlState] = useState('');
        const [testing, setTesting] = useState(false);
        const [testResult, setTestResult] = useState<{ ok: boolean; message: string } | null>(null);
        const [exporting, setExporting] = useState(false);
      
        useEffect(() => {
          setServerUrlState(getLocalServerUrl());
        }, []);
      
        const handleTestConnection = async () => {
          setTesting(true);
          setTestResult(null);
          try {
            const res = await fetch(`${serverUrl.replace(/\/$/, '')}/health`, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(4000) });
            if (res.ok) {
              const json = await res.json();
              setTestResult({
                ok: true,
                message: `Connected! Database: ${(json.database || 'active').toUpperCase()}`,
              });
              setLocalServerUrl(serverUrl);
            } else {
              setTestResult({ ok: false, message: `Server responded with status ${res.status}` });
            }
          } catch (err) {
            setTestResult({
              ok: false,
              message: `Connection failed: ${(err as Error).message}. Ensure the AttendX server is running.`,
            });
          } finally {
            setTesting(false);
          }
        };
      
        const handleExportBackup = async () => {
          setExporting(true);
          try {
            const res = await fetch(`${getLocalServerUrl()}/api/sync/export-json`);
            const blob = await res.blob();
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const anchor = document.createElement('a');
            anchor.href = url;
            anchor.download = 'attendx-backup.json';
            anchor.click();
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
          } finally {
            setExporting(false);
          }
        };
      
        return (
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '1.5rem', marginTop: '1.5rem' }}>
            {/* Server / Database connection */}
            <section className="panel">
              <div className="panel-head">
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.6rem' }}>
                  <Server size={20} />
                  <h2>Server & Database Connection</h2>
                </div>
              </div>
              <p style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', marginBottom: '1rem', fontSize: '0.9rem' }}>
                Connect this web application or mobile device to the AttendX server.
                Data is stored in MongoDB Atlas with an embedded fallback for offline use.
              </p>
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '0.75rem', alignItems: 'center', flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  className="text-input"
                  value={serverUrl}
                  onChange={(e) => setServerUrlState(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="http://localhost:3001 or http://192.168.1.50:3001"
                  style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: '280px' }}
                />
                <Button onClick={handleTestConnection} disabled={testing}>
                  <RefreshCw size={16} className={testing ? 'spin' : ''} />
                  {testing ? 'Testing...' : 'Test & Save'}
                </Button>
              </div>
              {testResult && (
                <div
                  style={{
                    marginTop: '0.75rem',
                    padding: '0.6rem 0.9rem',
                    borderRadius: '6px',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: '0.5rem',
                    fontSize: '0.88rem',
                    backgroundColor: testResult.ok ? 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.15)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)',
                    color: testResult.ok ? '#22c55e' : '#ef4444',
                  }}
                >
                  {testResult.ok ? <CheckCircle2 size={16} /> : <AlertCircle size={16} />}
                  {testResult.message}
                </div>
              )}
            </section>
      
            {/* Data & backup */}
            <section className="panel">
              <div className="panel-head">
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.6rem' }}>
                  <Database size={20} />
                  <h2>Data & Backup</h2>
                </div>
              </div>
              <p style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', marginBottom: '1rem', fontSize: '0.9rem' }}>
                Export a full JSON snapshot of the database — profiles, classes, attendance records, and queries.
              </p>
              <Button variant="secondary" onClick={handleExportBackup} disabled={exporting}>
                <Download size={16} />
                {exporting ? 'Preparing…' : 'Export Database Backup (JSON)'}
              </Button>
            </section>
      
            {/* Admin mass-mail */}
            <MassMailPanel />
      
            {/* Security note */}
            <section className="panel">
              <div className="panel-head">
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.6rem' }}>
                  <ShieldCheck size={20} />
                  <h2>Security</h2>
                </div>
              </div>
              <p style={{ color: 'var(--muted)', marginBottom: '0', fontSize: '0.9rem' }}>
                Password resets are verified by one-time codes sent through Gmail SMTP.
                Faculty accounts are activated with emailed invitation codes. Attendance
                queries are tracked with unique request numbers and resolved by email.
              </p>
            </section>
          </div>
        );
      }

  content: |
      import { Capacitor } from '@capacitor/core'
      import type { LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react'
      import { Bell, BookOpen, CalendarDays, ChevronDown, CircleUserRound, ClipboardCheck, Grid2X2, History, KeyRound, LifeBuoy, LogOut, Menu, QrCode, Server, Settings, ShieldCheck, Smartphone, Users, X, Database } from 'lucide-react'
      import { useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
      import type { Role } from '../types'
      import { useAppStore } from '../store'
      import { Initials, Logo, Button } from './ui'
      import { getLocalServerUrl, setLocalServerUrl } from '../lib/apiClient'
      import { UpdateBanner } from './UpdateBanner'
      
      export type ViewKey = 'home' | 'mark' | 'history' | 'classes' | 'session' | 'people' | 'passwords' | 'review' | 'settings' | 'invites' | 'profile' | 'queries'
      type Nav = { key: ViewKey; label: string; icon: LucideIcon }
      const navByRole: Record<Role, Nav[]> = {
        student: [{ key: 'home', label: 'Overview', icon: Grid2X2 }, { key: 'mark', label: 'Mark attendance', icon: QrCode }, { key: 'classes', label: 'My classes', icon: BookOpen }, { key: 'queries', label: 'Attendance help', icon: LifeBuoy }, { key: 'history', label: 'History', icon: History }],
        faculty: [{ key: 'home', label: 'Overview', icon: Grid2X2 }, { key: 'session', label: 'Live session', icon: QrCode }, { key: 'classes', label: 'My classes', icon: BookOpen }, { key: 'history', label: 'Attendance', icon: ClipboardCheck }],
        admin: [{ key: 'home', label: 'Overview', icon: Grid2X2 }, { key: 'people', label: 'People', icon: Users }, { key: 'passwords', label: 'Password requests', icon: KeyRound }, { key: 'classes', label: 'Classes', icon: CalendarDays }, { key: 'review', label: 'Review queue', icon: ShieldCheck }, { key: 'queries', label: 'Attendance queries', icon: LifeBuoy }, { key: 'history', label: 'Records', icon: ClipboardCheck }, { key: 'settings', label: 'Settings', icon: Settings }]
      }
      
      export function Shell({ view, setView, children }: { view: ViewKey; setView: (view: ViewKey) => void; children: ReactNode }) {
        const { role, profile, signOut } = useAppStore()
        const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false)
        const [serverModalOpen, setServerModalOpen] = useState(false)
        const [serverInput, setServerInput] = useState(getLocalServerUrl())
        const nav = navByRole[role]
        const select = (key: ViewKey) => { setView(key); setMenuOpen(false) }
      
        const saveServer = () => {
          setLocalServerUrl(serverInput)
          setServerModalOpen(false)
          window.location.reload()
        }
      
        const isNative = Capacitor.isNativePlatform()
      
        return <div className="app-shell">
          <aside className={`sidebar ${menuOpen ? 'sidebar-open' : ''}`}>
            <div className="sidebar-head"><Logo /><button className="icon-button sidebar-close" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)} aria-label="Close navigation"><X /></button></div>
            <nav className="main-nav" aria-label="Main navigation">
              <p className="nav-eyebrow">Workspace</p>
              {nav.map(({ key, label, icon: Icon }) => <button key={key} className={view === key ? 'active' : ''} onClick={() => select(key)}><Icon size={19}/><span>{label}</span></button>)}
            </nav>
            <div className="sidebar-foot">
              <button className="account-button" onClick={() => select('profile')}><Initials name={profile.full_name} /><span><strong>{profile.full_name}</strong><small>{profile.identifier}</small></span><ChevronDown size={16}/></button>
              <button className="signout" onClick={signOut}><LogOut size={17}/>Sign out</button>
            </div>
          </aside>
          {menuOpen && <button className="sidebar-scrim" aria-label="Close navigation" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(false)} />}
          <main className="workspace">
            <header className="topbar">
              <button className="icon-button menu-button" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(true)} aria-label="Open navigation"><Menu /></button>
              <div className="topbar-brand"><Logo compact /></div>
              <span className="role-chip">{role}</span>
              <button
                className="role-chip"
                style={{ cursor: 'pointer', background: 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)', color: '#34d399', border: '1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.4rem' }}
                onClick={() => setServerModalOpen(true)}
                title="Configure Server URL"
              >
                <Database size={14} />
                <span>MongoDB/Local</span>
              </button>
              <div className="topbar-actions">
                <button className="icon-button notification-button" aria-label="Notifications"><Bell size={20}/><i /></button>
                <button className="compact-profile" onClick={() => select('profile')}><Initials name={profile.full_name} size="sm"/><span>{profile.full_name.split(' ')[0]}</span></button>
              </div>
            </header>
            <div className="content"><UpdateBanner />{children}</div>
          </main>
          <nav className="mobile-nav">{nav.slice(0, 4).map(({ key, label, icon: Icon }) => <button key={key} className={view === key ? 'active' : ''} onClick={() => select(key)}><Icon size={20}/><span>{label.replace(' attendance', '')}</span></button>)}<button className={view === 'profile' ? 'active' : ''} onClick={() => select('profile')}><CircleUserRound size={20}/><span>Profile</span></button></nav>
      
          {serverModalOpen && (
            <div className="modal-backdrop" onClick={() => setServerModalOpen(false)}>
              <div className="modal-content" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} style={{ maxWidth: '440px', padding: '1.5rem' }}>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
                  <h3 style={{ margin: 0, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
                    <Server size={18} /> Backend Server Connection
                  </h3>
                  <button className="icon-button" onClick={() => setServerModalOpen(false)}><X size={18}/></button>
                </div>
                <p style={{ fontSize: '0.88rem', color: 'var(--text-muted, #94a3b8)', marginBottom: '1rem' }}>
                  {isNative
                    ? 'Enter your laptop\'s IP address (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:3001) so the app can communicate with your local database.'
                    : 'When running AttendX on your phone or on Vercel, enter your laptop\'s IP address (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:3001) so the app can communicate with your local database.'
                  }
                </p>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  className="input"
                  value={serverInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setServerInput(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="http://localhost:3001"
                  style={{ width: '100%', marginBottom: '1rem' }}
                />
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'flex-end', gap: '0.5rem' }}>
                  <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setServerModalOpen(false)}>Cancel</Button>
                  <Button onClick={saveServer}>Save & Connect</Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      }
